item.dc:creator: trs-import

<!-- wp:html -->
<style id="hr-styles">
<!--
/* WordPress reset. From the Wellness Voucher build and the components kit (W01). It sits BEFORE the page CSS, at
   element strength, so every page rule still wins over it. It undoes the GeneratePress element styles that would
   otherwise bleed into the page (bare p/ul/blockquote/heading margins, body 15px, container padding). */
body{font-size:16px}
p,h1,h2,h3,h4,h5,h6,ul,ol,li,dl,dd,figure,blockquote,table{margin:0;padding:0;margin-block:0}
h1,h2,h3,h4,h5,h6{font-family:inherit;font-weight:bold;line-height:inherit;color:inherit;text-transform:none;letter-spacing:normal}
h1{font-size:2em}h2{font-size:1.5em}h3{font-size:1.17em}h4{font-size:1em}h5{font-size:.83em}h6{font-size:.67em}
blockquote{border:0;font-size:inherit;font-style:normal;position:static}
button{padding:0;font:revert;color:revert;letter-spacing:revert;text-transform:revert;line-height:revert}
.site-content,.content-area,.site-main,.inside-article,.entry-content,.site.grid-container,.container.grid-container{padding:0!important;margin:0!important;max-width:none!important;width:100%!important;float:none!important}
.entry-header,.page-header,.post-image,.featured-image{display:none!important}
body{-webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased;-moz-osx-font-smoothing:grayscale;text-rendering:optimizeLegibility;letter-spacing:normal}
table,td,th{border:0}
/* GeneratePress gives form controls the theme font and a 24px line-height; the review page left them at the browser default. */
input,select,textarea{font:revert;line-height:revert;letter-spacing:revert;color:revert}
/* WordPress's Details block adds a block gap between its parts (is-layout-flow). The review page has none. */
details.wp-block-details>*{margin-block-start:0;margin-block-end:0}

@font-face{font-family:'HR Inter';font-style:normal;font-weight:300 600;font-display:swap;src:url(https://www.tararosesalon.com/wp-content/themes/tara-rose-salon/assets/ae/fonts/inter-300.woff2) format('woff2')}
@font-face{font-family:'HR Playfair Display';font-style:normal;font-weight:400;font-display:swap;src:url(https://www.tararosesalon.com/wp-content/uploads/generatepress/fonts/playfair-display/PlayfairDisplay-Regular.woff2) format('woff2')}
@font-face{font-family:'HR Playfair Display';font-style:normal;font-weight:500;font-display:swap;src:url(https://www.tararosesalon.com/wp-content/themes/tara-rose-salon/assets/ae/fonts/playfair-display-500.woff2) format('woff2')}
@font-face{font-family:'HR Playfair Display';font-style:italic;font-weight:400 500;font-display:swap;src:url(https://www.tararosesalon.com/wp-content/themes/tara-rose-salon/assets/ae/fonts/playfair-display-500-italic.woff2) format('woff2')}
:where(.hr-run,.hr-loose){display:contents}
div:where(.hr-small){display:inline;font-size:smaller}
div:where(.hr-span){display:inline}
div:where(.hr-b){display:inline;font-weight:bolder}
div:where(.hr-em){display:inline;font-style:italic}
div:where(.hr-bq){display:block}
span:where(.hr-cite){font-style:italic}

/* css/voucher-base.css */
:root{--paper:#FAF8F4; --cream:#F1ECE3; --stone-soft:#EFEBE3; --stone:#E7E2D8; --sand:#E7DFD2;
  --ink:#2D2E37; --ink-deep:#1C1B18; --ink-soft:#74747B; --hair:rgba(45,46,55,.11);
  --accent:#99F6E4; --accent-deep:#7DE6D2; --accent-text:#1C7563; --accent-soft:#EEF3C7;
  --lime:#EEF3C7; --lavender:#C4B5FD; --coral:#FF9B9B; --err:#C9685F;
  --r-lg:22px; --r-md:16px; --r-sm:14px; --r-pill:100px;
  --ease:cubic-bezier(.22,.61,.36,1); --dur:.3s;
  --fd:"HR Playfair Display",Georgia,serif; --fb:"HR Inter",system-ui,-apple-system,sans-serif;
  --maxw:1180px; --pad-x:26px; --sec-y:96px;}
@media (max-width:900px){:root{--sec-y:64px;}}
@media (max-width:600px){:root{--sec-y:48px; --pad-x:20px;}}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){*,*::before,*::after{animation-duration:.01ms!important; transition-duration:.01ms!important;}}
*,*::before,*::after{margin:0; padding:0; box-sizing:border-box;}
html{scroll-behavior:smooth;}
body{font-family:var(--fb); color:var(--ink); background:var(--paper); line-height:1.62; -webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased; -moz-osx-font-smoothing:grayscale; text-rendering:optimizeLegibility; font-feature-settings:"kern","liga","calt"; overflow-x:hidden;}
h1,h2,h3,h4{font-optical-sizing:auto;}
img{max-width:100%; display:block;}
a{color:inherit; text-decoration:none;}
.wrap{max-width:var(--maxw); margin:0 auto; padding:0 var(--pad-x);}
section{padding:var(--sec-y) 0;}
.skip{position:absolute; top:-100px; left:16px; z-index:999; background:var(--ink); color:var(--paper); padding:12px 20px; border-radius:var(--r-pill); font-family:var(--fb); font-size:13px; font-weight:500;}
.skip:focus{top:12px;}
:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--accent-text); outline-offset:3px; border-radius:3px;}
.hr-eyebrow{font-family:var(--fb); font-size:11px; font-weight:500; letter-spacing:.4em; text-transform:uppercase; color:var(--ink-soft);}
.hr-h-1{font-family:var(--fd); font-weight:500; font-size:clamp(42px,min(6.2vw,9vh),80px); line-height:1.0; letter-spacing:-.018em; text-wrap:balance;}
.p{font-family:var(--fb); font-size:16px; font-weight:400; line-height:1.62; color:var(--ink);}
.hr-pill{display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:10px; font-family:var(--fb); font-size:13px; font-weight:500; letter-spacing:.04em; padding:14px 26px; border-radius:var(--r-pill); border:none; cursor:pointer; text-decoration:none; background:var(--ink); color:var(--paper); transition:transform var(--dur) var(--ease),background var(--dur) var(--ease),box-shadow var(--dur) var(--ease); box-shadow:0 1px 2px rgba(45,46,55,.10);}
.hr-pill .arr{transition:transform var(--dur) var(--ease);}
.hr-pill:hover .arr{transform:translateX(4px);}
.hr-pill:hover{transform:translateY(-2px); background:#3b3c47; box-shadow:0 11px 24px -10px rgba(45,46,55,.42);}
.pill--accent{background:var(--accent); color:var(--ink); box-shadow:0 1px 2px rgba(61,140,127,.20);}
.pill--accent:hover{background:var(--accent-deep); box-shadow:0 12px 26px -10px rgba(61,140,127,.5);}
.cta-row{display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; gap:18px; flex-wrap:wrap; margin-top:30px;}
.trs-nav{position:sticky; top:0; z-index:60; background:rgba(250,248,244,.86); backdrop-filter:blur(12px); -webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(12px); border-bottom:1px solid var(--hair); transition:box-shadow .4s var(--ease),background .4s var(--ease);}
.trs-nav.scrolled{box-shadow:0 8px 30px -18px rgba(45,46,55,.28); background:rgba(250,248,244,.94);}
.trs-nav .navrow{display:grid; grid-template-columns:1fr auto 1fr; align-items:center; height:74px;}
.trs-nav .brand{display:flex; flex-direction:column; align-items:center; line-height:1; justify-self:center; padding:0 clamp(18px,2.6vw,44px);}
.trs-nav .brand__tick{width:34px; height:2px; background:var(--accent-deep); margin-bottom:8px;}
.trs-nav .brand__wm{font-family:var(--fd); font-weight:500; font-size:21px; letter-spacing:.32em; color:var(--ink);}
.trs-nav .brand :is(small,div:where(.hr-small),:is(span,div:where(.hr-span),span:where(.hr-span)):where(.hr-small)){display:block; font-family:var(--fb); font-weight:500; font-size:8.5px; letter-spacing:.44em; color:var(--ink-soft); margin-top:5px; text-align:center;}
.trs-nav .nav__cta{justify-self:start; padding:11px 20px; font-size:12px;}
.trs-nav .nav-link{justify-self:end; font-family:var(--fb); font-size:11.5px; font-weight:600; letter-spacing:.16em; text-transform:uppercase; color:var(--ink-soft);}
.trs-nav .nav-link:hover{color:var(--ink);}
@media (max-width:600px){.trs-nav .nav-link{display:none;}.trs-nav .nav__cta{font-size:11px; padding:10px 16px;}.trs-nav .brand__wm{font-size:18px;}}
.hero-c{position:relative; overflow:hidden; background:var(--ink-deep); color:#fff; padding:112px 0 100px;}
.hero-c::before{content:""; position:absolute; inset:0; background:linear-gradient(150deg,#C9A98C,#4F3D30); opacity:.16;}
.hero-c::after{content:""; position:absolute; inset:0; background:url("data:image/svg+xml,<svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' width='150' height='150'><filter id='n2'><feTurbulence type='fractalNoise' baseFrequency='0.85' numOctaves='2' stitchTiles='stitch'/><feColorMatrix type='saturate' values='0'/></filter><rect width='150' height='150' filter='url(%23n2)' opacity='0.14'/></svg>") repeat; pointer-events:none;}
.hero-c .inner{position:relative; z-index:2; max-width:820px; margin:0 auto; text-align:center;}
.pill-tag{display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:9px; background:rgba(255,255,255,.06); padding:9px 18px; border-radius:var(--r-pill); font-family:var(--fb); font-size:11px; letter-spacing:.2em; text-transform:uppercase; font-weight:600; color:rgba(255,255,255,.9); margin-bottom:26px;}
.pill-tag .dot{width:7px; height:7px; border-radius:50%; background:var(--accent); box-shadow:0 0 0 4px rgba(153,246,228,.32);}
.hero-c h1{color:#fff; max-width:18ch; margin-left:auto; margin-right:auto;}
.hero-c h1 :is(em,div:where(.hr-em),span:where(.hr-em)){font-style:italic; color:var(--accent);}
.hero-c .hr-lede{margin:22px auto 0; max-width:540px; color:rgba(255,255,255,.8); font-size:18px; font-weight:300;}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion:no-preference){@keyframes pulse{ 0%,100%{ box-shadow:0 0 0 0 rgba(153,246,228,.5) } 50%{ box-shadow:0 0 0 7px rgba(153,246,228,0) } }}
.hero-c .lede-life{display:block}
.hero-c .lede-life{font-size:18px; line-height:1.45; color:rgba(255,255,255,.94); margin-bottom:12px}
@media (max-width:1023px){.hero-c .pill-tag{padding-top:7px; padding-bottom:7px;}.hero-c h1{line-height:1.02;}.hero-c .lede-life{margin-bottom:10px;}.hero-c .cta-row{margin-top:10px;}}
@media (max-width:400px){.hero-c .lede-life{font-size:17px; line-height:1.4;}}
@media (min-width:1024px) and (max-height:920px){.hero-c .lede-life{font-size:17px; margin-bottom:10px;}.hero-c .cta-row{margin-top:10px;}.hero-c .lede-life{font-size:16.5px;}}
@media (min-width:1024px) and (max-height:920px){.hero-c h1{font-size:54px; line-height:1.04;}.hero-c .hr-lede{font-size:15.5px; line-height:1.5; margin-top:12px; max-width:560px;}.hero-c .cta-row{margin-top:14px;}}
.hero-c .inner .cta-row{justify-content:center;}
.trust{border-top:1px solid var(--hair); border-bottom:1px solid var(--hair);}
.trust .row{display:flex; justify-content:center; gap:44px; padding:22px 0; flex-wrap:wrap;}
.trust .row>:is(span,div:where(.hr-span),span:where(.hr-span)){display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:10px; font-family:var(--fb); font-size:11.5px; letter-spacing:.2em; color:var(--ink-soft); text-transform:uppercase; font-weight:600;}
.trust .tick-i{width:14px; height:2px; background:var(--accent-deep); display:inline-block;}
.hr-dark{background:var(--ink-deep); color:#fff;}
.hr-dark .hr-eyebrow{color:rgba(255,255,255,.55);}
.hr-dark h2,.hr-dark h3{color:#fff;}
.hr-sec-head{max-width:640px; margin-bottom:44px;}
.hr-sec-head.center{margin-left:auto; margin-right:auto; text-align:center;}
.hr-sec-head .hr-eyebrow{display:block; margin-bottom:14px;}
.hr-sec-head h2{font-family:var(--fd); font-weight:500; font-size:clamp(31px,4.4vw,52px); line-height:1.05; letter-spacing:-.012em; color:var(--ink); text-wrap:balance;}
.hr-dark .hr-sec-head h2{color:#fff;}
.hr-grid-3{display:grid; grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr); gap:20px;}
@media (max-width:860px){.hr-grid-3{grid-template-columns:1fr;}}
.faq details{border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.12); padding:4px 0;}
.faq details:first-of-type{border-top:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.12);}
.faq summary{cursor:pointer; list-style:none; padding:22px 0; display:flex; justify-content:space-between; align-items:center; gap:20px; font-family:var(--fd); font-weight:500; font-size:clamp(19px,2.2vw,24px); color:#fff;}
.faq summary::-webkit-details-marker{display:none;}
.faq .chev{flex:0 0 auto; width:22px; height:22px; position:relative;}
.faq .chev::before,.faq .chev::after{content:""; position:absolute; background:var(--accent); border-radius:2px;}
.faq .chev::before{top:10px; left:3px; right:3px; height:2px;}
.faq .chev::after{left:10px; top:3px; bottom:3px; width:2px; transition:opacity var(--dur) var(--ease);}
.faq details[open] .chev::after{opacity:0;}
.faq .ans{padding:0 0 24px; max-width:62ch; font-family:var(--fb); font-size:16px; font-weight:300; line-height:1.6; color:rgba(255,255,255,.72);}
.reserve{background:var(--stone-soft);}
.reserve .inner{max-width:720px; margin:0 auto;}
.field{margin-bottom:18px;}
.field label{display:block; font-family:var(--fb); font-size:12px; font-weight:600; letter-spacing:.1em; text-transform:uppercase; color:var(--ink); margin-bottom:8px;}
.field label.pdpl__label{text-transform:none; letter-spacing:0; font-weight:400; font-size:13.5px; line-height:1.5; color:var(--ink-soft);}
.field label.pdpl__label strong{color:var(--ink); font-weight:600;}
.field label .req{color:var(--accent-text);}
.field input{width:100%; font-family:var(--fb); font-size:15px; color:var(--ink); background:var(--paper); border:1px solid var(--hair); border-radius:var(--r-sm); padding:14px 16px; transition:border-color var(--dur) var(--ease);}
.field input:focus{outline:2px solid var(--accent-deep); outline-offset:3px; border-color:var(--accent-deep);}
.field input::placeholder{color:var(--ink-soft); opacity:.7;}
.phone-wrap{display:grid; grid-template-columns:96px 1fr; gap:10px;}
.phone-wrap select{font-family:var(--fb); font-size:15px; color:var(--ink); background:var(--paper); border:1px solid var(--hair); border-radius:var(--r-sm); padding:14px 12px;}
.reserve .submit-row{margin-top:28px;}
.reserve .submit-row .hr-pill{width:100%; justify-content:center; padding:18px 40px; font-size:14px;}
.pdpl{background:var(--paper); border:1px solid var(--hair); border-radius:var(--r-md); padding:20px 22px; margin:24px 0 6px; font-family:var(--fb);}
.pdpl__group{display:flex; align-items:flex-start; gap:12px; margin-bottom:14px;}
.pdpl__group:last-of-type{margin-bottom:0;}
.pdpl__checkbox{flex-shrink:0; width:20px; height:20px; margin-top:2px; border:1.5px solid var(--ink-soft); border-radius:4px; background:var(--paper); cursor:pointer; appearance:none; position:relative; transition:border-color var(--dur) var(--ease),background var(--dur) var(--ease);}
.pdpl__checkbox:hover{border-color:var(--ink);}
.pdpl__checkbox:checked{background:var(--accent-deep); border-color:var(--accent-deep);}
.pdpl__checkbox:checked::after{content:""; position:absolute; left:5px; top:1px; width:6px; height:12px; border:solid var(--ink); border-width:0 2px 2px 0; transform:rotate(45deg);}
.pdpl__label{font-size:13.5px; font-weight:400; line-height:1.55; color:var(--ink); cursor:pointer;}
.pdpl__label :is(span,div:where(.hr-span),span:where(.hr-span)){color:var(--ink-soft);}
.pdpl__note{font-size:12px; color:var(--ink-soft); line-height:1.6; padding-top:12px; border-top:1px solid var(--hair); margin-top:14px;}
.pdpl__note strong{color:var(--ink); font-weight:600;}
.pdpl__note a{color:var(--accent-text); border-bottom:1px solid var(--accent-deep);}
.foot{background:#161512; color:#fff; padding:84px 0 32px;}
.foot .row{display:grid; grid-template-columns:1.4fr 1fr 1fr; gap:48px; padding-bottom:42px; border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.1);}
.foot h4{font-family:var(--fb); font-size:11px; font-weight:600; letter-spacing:.24em; text-transform:uppercase; color:rgba(255,255,255,.55); margin-bottom:18px;}
.foot p,.foot a{font-family:var(--fb); font-size:13.5px; color:rgba(255,255,255,.72); line-height:1.72; font-weight:300;}
.foot a:hover{color:#fff;}
.foot .brand__wm{font-family:var(--fd); font-weight:500; font-size:24px; letter-spacing:.28em; color:#fff; margin-bottom:6px; display:block;}
.foot .sig{font-family:var(--fd); font-style:italic; color:var(--accent); font-size:16px; margin-top:22px; display:block;}
.foot__legal{padding:20px 0; border-top:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.1); color:rgba(255,255,255,.55); font-size:12px; line-height:1.7; margin-top:24px;}
.foot__legal a{color:rgba(255,255,255,.72); text-decoration:underline;}
.foot .subrow{padding-top:24px; display:flex; justify-content:space-between; color:rgba(255,255,255,.5); font-size:11.5px; letter-spacing:.06em;}
.foot .subrow a{color:rgba(255,255,255,.5);}
.foot .permit{font-size:12px; color:rgba(255,255,255,.5); line-height:1.7; margin-top:14px;}
@media (max-width:780px){.foot .row{grid-template-columns:1fr; gap:32px;}.foot .subrow{flex-direction:column; gap:8px;}}
[aria-invalid="true"]{border-color:#8E2F20 !important;}
.press-strip .press-row{display:flex; flex-wrap:wrap; justify-content:center; align-items:stretch; gap:0; max-width:1140px; margin:0 auto;}
.press-strip .press-row a{display:flex; flex-direction:column; align-items:center; justify-content:flex-start; gap:9px;
  padding:4px 26px; text-decoration:none; border-left:1px solid var(--hair);
  transition:color .3s var(--ease);}
.press-strip .press-row a::before{content:none}
.press-logo-box{height:50px; display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center}
.press-strip .press-row a:first-child{border-left:0}
.press-logo{display:block; width:auto; filter:brightness(0) saturate(100%); opacity:.9;
  transition:opacity .3s var(--ease), transform .3s var(--ease);
  image-rendering:-webkit-optimize-contrast;}
.press-logo--cosmo{height:24px}
.press-logo--hb{height:33px}
.press-logo--pb{height:46px}
.press-logo--ent{height:38px}
.press-logo--bw{height:41px}
.press-strip .press-row a:hover .press-logo{opacity:1; transform:translateY(-2px)}
.press-sub{font-family:var(--fb); font-size:10px; font-weight:500; letter-spacing:.15em;
  text-transform:uppercase; color:var(--ink-soft); white-space:nowrap;}
.press-strip .press-row a:hover .press-sub{color:var(--ink)}
@media (max-width:820px){.press-strip .press-row a{padding:12px 16px; border-left:0}.press-sub{font-size:9.5px; letter-spacing:.12em}.press-logo-box{height:42px}.press-logo--cosmo{height:19px}.press-logo--hb{height:27px}.press-logo--pb{height:37px}.press-logo--ent{height:30px}.press-logo--bw{height:33px}}
.tcard{position:relative; background:var(--paper); border:1px solid var(--hair);
  border-radius:var(--r-md); padding:26px 26px 24px; box-shadow:none;
  transition:border-color .3s var(--ease);}
.tcard:hover{border-color:var(--accent-deep)}
.tcard::before{content:"“"; position:absolute; top:8px; right:20px;
  font-family:var(--fd); font-size:56px; line-height:1; color:var(--accent-deep); opacity:.34;}
.tcard .stars{display:block; color:var(--accent-text); font-size:11px; letter-spacing:.32em; margin:0 0 12px}
.tcard div:where(.hr-bq){position:relative; margin:0; font-family:var(--fb); font-size:14.5px; font-weight:300; line-height:1.62; color:var(--ink)}
.tcard :is(span,div:where(.hr-span),span:where(.hr-span)):where(.hr-cite){display:block; margin-top:16px; padding-top:14px; border-top:1px solid var(--hair); font-family:var(--fd); font-style:italic; font-size:15px; color:var(--ink)}
.tcard :is(span,div:where(.hr-span),span:where(.hr-span)):where(.hr-cite) :is(span,div:where(.hr-span),span:where(.hr-span)){display:block; margin-top:4px; font-family:var(--fb); font-style:normal;
  font-size:10px; font-weight:500; letter-spacing:.15em; text-transform:uppercase; color:var(--ink-soft);}
@media (max-width:760px){.trs-nav .brand,.trs-nav .nav-link{min-height:44px; display:inline-flex; align-items:center}footer a{display:inline-block; padding:11px 0; line-height:1.25}.cta-row .nav-link{min-height:44px; display:inline-flex; align-items:center}.pdpl__label{min-height:44px; display:flex; align-items:center; padding:6px 0}.press-sub{font-size:10px !important; letter-spacing:.12em}}
div:where(.entry-content) > section{border-top:1px solid var(--hair)}
div:where(.entry-content) > section.hr-dark,div:where(.entry-content) > section.hero-c{border-top:0}
div:where(.entry-content) > section.hr-dark + section{border-top:0}
.terms{max-width:66ch; margin:30px auto 0; border:1px solid var(--hair); border-radius:var(--r-md); background:var(--paper)}
.terms summary{list-style:none; cursor:pointer; padding:15px 22px; display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:space-between; gap:14px; font-family:var(--fb); font-size:12.5px; font-weight:500; letter-spacing:.04em; color:var(--ink)}
.terms summary::-webkit-details-marker{display:none}
.terms summary::after{content:"+"; font-family:var(--fb); font-size:17px; line-height:1; color:var(--accent-text); transition:transform .3s var(--ease)}
.terms[open] summary::after{content:"−"}
.terms summary:hover{color:var(--accent-text)}
[id]{scroll-margin-top:84px}

.hr-pill{display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; gap:10px;
font-family:var(--fb); font-size:13px; font-weight:500; letter-spacing:.04em;
padding:14px 26px; border-radius:var(--r-pill);
border:1.5px solid transparent;   
cursor:pointer; text-decoration:none;
background:var(--ink); color:var(--paper); box-shadow:var(--sh-btn);
transition:transform var(--dur) var(--ease), background var(--dur) var(--ease),
border-color var(--dur) var(--ease), box-shadow var(--dur) var(--ease);}
.hr-pill:hover{transform:translateY(-2px); background:#3B3C47; box-shadow:var(--sh-btn-hover);}
.hr-pill:active{transform:translateY(0);}
.pill--accent{background:var(--accent); color:var(--ink); box-shadow:var(--sh-cta);}
.pill--accent:hover{background:var(--accent-deep); box-shadow:var(--sh-cta-hover);}
.hr-pill .arr{transition:transform var(--dur) var(--ease);}
.hr-pill:hover .arr{transform:translateX(4px);}
.wrap{margin-inline:auto; padding-inline:var(--pad-x);}
section{padding-block:var(--sec-y);}
.hr-h-1{font-family:var(--fd); font-weight:500; font-size:clamp(42px,6.4vw,74px);

and it went austere. The discipline is right for PROSE - body copy in a warm

/* css/blonde-standard.css */
body{overflow-x:clip;}
.trs-nav .brand__wm{font-family:var(--fb); font-weight:400;}
.foot .brand__wm{font-family:var(--fb); font-weight:400;}
.hr-dark .faq .ans{font-weight:400;}
.because{margin:20px 0 0; padding-top:16px; border-top:1px solid var(--hair);
  font-family:var(--fd) !important; font-style:italic; font-weight:500 !important;
  font-size:16.5px !important; line-height:1.5 !important; color:var(--ink) !important;}
.because :is(span,div:where(.hr-span),span:where(.hr-span)){display:block; margin-bottom:6px;
  font-family:var(--fb); font-style:normal; font-size:10.5px; font-weight:600;
  letter-spacing:.22em; text-transform:uppercase; color:var(--accent-text);}
.field select,.field textarea{width:100%; font-family:var(--fb); font-size:16px; color:var(--ink);
  background:var(--paper); border:1px solid var(--hair); border-radius:var(--r-sm);
  padding:14px 16px; transition:border-color var(--dur) var(--ease);}
.field input{font-size:16px;}
.field textarea{resize:vertical; min-height:96px; line-height:1.6;}
.field select:focus,.field textarea:focus{outline:2px solid var(--accent-deep); outline-offset:3px; border-color:var(--accent-deep);}
.pdpl__group{align-items:center;}
.pdpl__label{padding:11px 0;}
.hr-eyebrow{font-size:12.5px; letter-spacing:.3em;}

#rhythm,#promise,#book,#faq{scroll-margin-top:calc(var(--nav-h,75px) + 16px);}
.phone-wrap{grid-template-columns:auto 1fr;}
/* css/offers.css */
.offer-nav{background:var(--cream); border-bottom:1px solid var(--hair);
  padding:10px 0; position:sticky; top:var(--nav-h,75px); z-index:50;
  transition:box-shadow .28s var(--ease);}
.offer-nav.stuck{box-shadow:0 14px 28px -22px rgba(45,46,55,.55);}

.offer-nav .wrap{display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; gap:14px;}
.offer-nav__row{display:flex; flex-wrap:wrap; justify-content:center; gap:8px;
  list-style:none; margin:0; padding:0;}
.ochip{display:inline-flex; align-items:center; min-height:44px; padding:0 18px;
  border-radius:var(--r-pill); background:var(--paper); border:1.5px solid var(--ink);
  font-family:var(--fb); font-size:12.5px; font-weight:600; letter-spacing:.1em;
  text-transform:uppercase; color:var(--ink); white-space:nowrap; text-decoration:none;
  transition:background var(--dur) var(--ease), color var(--dur) var(--ease);}
.ochip:hover,.ochip:focus-visible{background:var(--ink); color:var(--paper);}
.ochip.active{background:var(--ink); color:var(--paper);}

<details class="wp-block-details hr-q"><summary>Is a junior stylist experienced enough?<span class="chev">​</span></summary><!-- wp:generateblocks/text {"uniqueId":"f7f06970","tagName":"div","className":"ans"} -->
<div class="gb-text ans">She is a specialist in the appointments she does most. Every one of them is trained the Tara Rose way and supervised by senior team members on everything she offers you.</div>

<!-- /wp:details -->

<!-- wp:details {"className":"hr-q"} -->
<details class="wp-block-details hr-q"><summary>How often should I come in?<span class="chev">​</span></summary><!-- wp:generateblocks/text {"uniqueId":"ac51a9fb","tagName":"div","className":"ans"} -->
<div class="gb-text ans">Your stylist will talk you through a rhythm that suits your hair. A common one is colour, a Tone Reset at week four or five, a blow-dry or treatment around week eight, then colour again around week ten.</div>
<!-- /wp:generateblocks/text --></details>
<!-- /wp:details -->

<!-- wp:details {"className":"hr-q"} -->
<details class="wp-block-details hr-q"><summary>What does it cost?<span class="chev">​</span></summary><!-- wp:generateblocks/text {"uniqueId":"1045c7e2","tagName":"div","className":"ans"} -->
<div class="gb-text ans">Tone Resets start at AED 220, treatments at AED 210 and blow-dry packages from AED 264. Your price depends on the service and your length, and your salon confirms the final price.</div>
<!-- /wp:generateblocks/text --></details>
<!-- /wp:details -->

<!-- wp:details {"className":"hr-q"} -->
<details class="wp-block-details hr-q"><summary>How long do packages last?<span class="chev">​</span></summary><!-- wp:generateblocks/text {"uniqueId":"ce836bde","tagName":"div","className":"ans"} -->
<div class="gb-text ans">The Blow-dry Edit and Series are valid for one month from purchase, Four Weeks for six weeks from your first booking and treatment courses for three months (a course of three) or six months (a course of five). Moving an appointment needs 48 hours’ notice, and prepaid sessions are not refundable. Prepaid sessions cannot be booked in December or on public holidays, and your validity is extended by those days.</div>
<!-- /wp:generateblocks/text --></details>
<!-- /wp:details -->

<!-- wp:details {"className":"hr-q"} -->
<details class="wp-block-details hr-q"><summary>How do deposits and the Confidence Promise work?<span class="chev">​</span></summary><!-- wp:generateblocks/text {"uniqueId":"1818149e","tagName":"div","className":"ans"} -->
<div class="gb-text ans">Some appointments need a deposit, such as longer or higher-value services. /* Level the Blonde Menu cards: intros get the height of the tallest when the cards sit side by side. */
(function(){
  var ps=[].slice.call(document.querySelectorAll('.gcards .plancard__body>p'));
  if(!ps.length) return;
  var level=function(){
    ps.forEach(function(p){ p.style.minHeight=''; });
    var cards=document.querySelectorAll('.gcards .gcard');
    if(cards.length<2||cards[0].getBoundingClientRect().top!==cards[1].getBoundingClientRect().top) return;
    var h=Math.max.apply(null,ps.map(function(p){ return p.getBoundingClientRect().height; }));
    ps.forEach(function(p){ p.style.minHeight=h+'px'; });
  };
  window.addEventListener('resize',level,{passive:true});
  window.addEventListener('load',level);
  if(document.fonts&&document.fonts.ready) document.fonts.ready.then(level);
  level();
})();
//-->
</script>

/* Level the "what's included" lists so prices line up when cards sit side by side. */

<script>
<!--
/* Length switch: one choice sets every price on the page, and Book now carries her length (and, for packages, the price) to reception. */
(function(){
  var NAMES=['short','medium','long','extra long'];
  var P={
    'o-colour':{label:'Choose 1 colour maintenance service',from:[220,280,335,450],inc:'Already includes a blow-dry to finish, every time.'},
    'o-treatment':{label:'Choose 1 treatment service',from:[210,220,230,270],course:[625,660,700,805]},
    'plan-edit':{label:'3 blow-dries',exact:[264,300,336,444],n:3},
    'plan-series':{label:'4 blow-dries',exact:[352,400,448,592],n:4},
    'plan-four-weeks':{label:'8 blow-dries',exact:[705,800,895,1185],n:8}
  };
  var fmt=function(v){ return 'AED '+v.toLocaleString('en-US'); };
  var boxes=[].slice.call(document.querySelectorAll('[data-price]'));
  if(!boxes.length) return;
  var orig={};
  boxes.forEach(function(b){ orig[b.getAttribute('data-price')]=b.innerHTML; });
  var books=[].slice.call(document.querySelectorAll('.js-book'));
  books.forEach(function(a){ a.setAttribute('data-book-base',a.getAttribute('data-book')||''); });
  var cardOf=function(el){ var c=el.closest('.plancard'); return c?c.id:''; };
  var apply=function(i){
    window.hrLen=i;
    document.querySelectorAll('.len-switch button').forEach(function(btn){ btn.setAttribute('aria-pressed',String(Number(btn.getAttribute('data-len'))===i)); });
    boxes.forEach(function(b){
      var id=b.getAttribute('data-price'), d=P[id]; if(!d) return;
      if(i<0){ b.innerHTML=orig[id]; return; }
      var hair=NAMES[i]+' hair', small, big;
      if(d.exact){ big=fmt(d.exact[i]); small='about AED '+(d.per||Math.round(d.exact[i]/d.n))+' a blow-dry'; b.querySelector('span').textContent=d.label+', '+hair; }
      else{ big=fmt(d.from[i]); small=d.course?'For a visit. Courses of three from '+fmt(d.course[i]):(d.inc?d.inc+' ':'')+'Your salon confirms the final price'; b.querySelector('span').textContent=d.label+', '+hair+', from'; }
      b.querySelector('strong').textContent=big;
      b.querySelector('small').textContent=small;
    });
    document.querySelectorAll('.gcard__cols>div, .gsvc__lens:not(.gsvc__lens--one)').forEach(function(row){
      [].slice.call(row.children).forEach(function(c,k){ c.classList.toggle('is-len',k===i); });
    });
    books.forEach(function(a){
      var base=a.getAttribute('data-book-base'); if(i<0){ a.setAttribute('data-book',base); return; }
      var d=P[cardOf(a)], extra=', '+NAMES[i]+' hair'+(window.hrDens?' ('+window.hrDens+')':'');
      if(d&&d.exact) extra+=' ('+fmt(d.exact[i])+')';
      a.setAttribute('data-book',base+extra);
    });
  };
  document.querySelectorAll('.len-switch button').forEach(function(btn){

  });
  var saved=-1; try{ localStorage.removeItem('hr_len'); }catch(e){}
  window.hrApplyLen=function(i){ apply(i); if(window.hrLevel) window.hrLevel(); };
  apply(saved>=0&&saved<4?saved:-1);
})();
//-->
</script>

    p.setAttribute('role','button'); p.setAttribute('tabindex','0'); p.setAttribute('aria-label','Enlarge the hair length guide');
    var z=document.createElement('span'); z.className='lf__zoom'; z.setAttribute('aria-hidden','true');
    z.innerHTML='<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"><circle cx="10.5" cy="10.5" r="6"/><path d="M15 15l5 5M10.5 8v5M8 10.5h5"/></svg>';
    p.appendChild(z);
    p.addEventListener('click',function(){ open(p); });
    p.addEventListener('keydown',function(e){ if(e.key==='Enter'||e.key===' '){ e.preventDefault(); open(p); } });
  });
  x.addEventListener('click',close);
  lb.addEventListener('click',function(e){ if(e.target===lb) close(); });
  document.addEventListener('keydown',function(e){
    if(lb.hidden) return;
    if(e.key==='Escape'){ e.stopImmediatePropagation(); close(); }
    else if(e.key==='Tab'){ e.preventDefault(); x.focus(); }
  },true);
})();
//-->
</script>
<script>
<!--
/* Sticky menu: the chip for the option on screen is the dark one, and the row scrolls to keep it in view. */
(function(){
  var bar=document.querySelector('.offer-nav'); if(!bar) return;
  var chips=[].slice.call(bar.querySelectorAll('.ochip')), row=bar.querySelector('.offer-nav__row');
  var targets=chips.map(function(a){ return document.getElementById(a.getAttribute('href').slice(1)); });
  var nav=document.querySelector('.trs-nav'), tick=false, last=-2;
  var run=function(){
    tick=false;
    var top=(nav?nav.offsetHeight:75)+bar.offsetHeight+Math.round(window.innerHeight*0.3), cur=-1;
    targets.forEach(function(t,i){ if(t&&t.getBoundingClientRect().top<=top) cur=i; });
    if(cur===last) return; last=cur;
    chips.forEach(function(a,i){ a.classList.toggle('active',i===cur); });
    if(cur>-1&&row.scrollWidth>row.clientWidth) row.scrollTo({left:chips[cur].offsetLeft-row.offsetLeft-12,behavior:'smooth'});
  };
  window.addEventListener('scroll',function(){ if(!tick){ tick=true; setTimeout(run,50); } },{passive:true});
  window.addEventListener('resize',run,{passive:true});
  run();
})();
//-->
</script>
<script>
<!--
/* Nav shadow on scroll, the sticky offer nav's numbers, and the scroll-spy.
   --nav-h and --sticky-h are measured rather than hard-coded, because the offer
   nav wraps to two rows of chips on a phone and the anchor offsets have to clear
   whatever it actually renders at. .stuck adds the drop shadow only while the bar
   is docked under the brand nav.
   The spy keeps the URL hash and the highlighted chip matched to the group on
   screen while she scrolls (Kate, 25 Aug: the URL said blow-dries while she was
   reading courses). replaceState, not pushState, so back does not replay every
   group she scrolled past. The blonde band is in the spy map without a chip: the
   hash says where she is, and no chip pretends to be it. */
(function(){
  var nav=document.querySelector('.trs-nav');
  if(!nav) return;
  var bar=document.querySelector('.offer-nav');
  var zone=document.querySelector('.menu-zone');
  var root=document.documentElement;
  var SPY=['o-plans','o-menu']
    .map(function(id){ return document.getElementById(id); }).filter(Boolean);
  var chips={};
  document.querySelectorAll('.ochip').forEach(function(a){
    chips[a.getAttribute('href').slice(1)]=a;
  });
  var lastSpy=null, ticking=false;

  var measure=function(){
    var nh=nav.offsetHeight;
    root.style.setProperty('--nav-h',nh+'px');
    if(bar) root.style.setProperty('--sticky-h',(nh+bar.offsetHeight+16)+'px');
  };

  var spy=function(){
    if(!zone||!SPY.length) return;
    var offset=nav.offsetHeight+(bar?bar.offsetHeight:0)+24;
    /* A group counts as "on screen" once its heading has risen into the top 40% of the
       window below the sticky bars, so the chip changes when she is reading the new group,
       not only when its heading touches the bars. */
    var lead=offset+Math.round(window.innerHeight*0.4);
    var current=null;
    if(zone.getBoundingClientRect().bottom>offset){
      for(var i=0;i<SPY.length;i++){
        if(SPY[i].getBoundingClientRect().top<=lead) current=SPY[i].id;
      }
    }
    if(current===lastSpy) return;
    lastSpy=current;
    try{ history.replaceState(null,'',current?'#'+current:location.pathname+location.search); }catch(e){}
    for(var id in chips) chips[id].classList.toggle('active',id===current);
  };

  var os=function(){
    nav.classList.toggle('scrolled', window.scrollY>14);
    if(bar) bar.classList.toggle('stuck',
      window.scrollY>0 && bar.getBoundingClientRect().top<=nav.offsetHeight+1);
    if(!ticking){
      ticking=true;
      requestAnimationFrame(function(){ ticking=false; spy(); });
    }
  };

  window.addEventListener('scroll',os,{passive:true});
  window.addEventListener('resize',measure,{passive:true});
  window.addEventListener('load',measure);
  /* The chip rows reflow when the webfont swaps in, so measure again after it. */
  if(document.fonts&&document.fonts.ready) document.fonts.ready.then(measure);
  measure(); os();
})();
//-->
</script>
<script>
<!--
/* Tracking layer, Layer 5 F. Fills the hidden fields. No third-party script, no
   cookie of our own beyond the two stores below, so nothing here needs consent.
   TEMPLATE: swap __FORM_ENDPOINT__ for the GHL inbound webhook. Inert until set. */
(function(){
  /* Salon numbers from each Google Business Profile, checked 13 Oct 2026. Motor City's WhatsApp is the 52 496 0903 line (Kate, 13 Oct 2026); its GBP shows the landline. */
  var SALON_LINKS='<a href="https://wa.me/971502811494" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Khalifa City A</a>, <a href="https://wa.me/971501968720" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Mamsha Al Saadiyat</a>, <a href="https://wa.me/971556245520" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Al Quoz</a>, or <a href="https://wa.me/971524960903" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Motor City</a>';
  var FORM_ENDPOINT="__FORM_ENDPOINT__";
  var f=document.querySelector('#book form'); if(!f) return;
  var q=new URLSearchParams(location.search);
  var set=function(n,v){ var el=f.querySelector('[name="'+n+'"]'); if(el&&v!=null&&v!=='') el.value=v; };
  var store=function(k,v){ try{ localStorage.setItem(k,v); }catch(e){} };
  var load=function(k){ try{ return localStorage.getItem(k); }catch(e){ return null; } };
  var cookie=function(n){ var m=document.cookie.match('(^|; )'+n+'=([^;]*)'); return m?decodeURIComponent(m[2]):''; };

  ['utm_source','utm_medium','utm_campaign','utm_content','utm_term'].forEach(function(k){ set(k, q.get(k)||''); });
  var gclid=q.get('gclid')||load('trs_gclid'), fbclid=q.get('fbclid')||load('trs_fbclid');
  if(q.get('gclid')) store('trs_gclid',q.get('gclid'));
  if(q.get('fbclid')) store('trs_fbclid',q.get('fbclid'));
  set('gclid',gclid); set('fbclid',fbclid);
  set('fbp',cookie('_fbp'));
  set('fbc', cookie('_fbc') || (fbclid ? 'fb.1.'+Date.now()+'.'+fbclid : ''));

  var touch=JSON.stringify({src:q.get('utm_source')||'',med:q.get('utm_medium')||'',cmp:q.get('utm_campaign')||'',ref:document.referrer||'',path:location.pathname});
  if(!load('trs_first_touch')) store('trs_first_touch',touch);
  set('first_touch', load('trs_first_touch')||touch);
  set('last_touch', touch);
  set('landing_path', load('trs_landing_path') || (store('trs_landing_path',location.pathname), location.pathname));
  set('referrer', document.referrer||'');

  /* Session ref, so a WhatsApp thread can be matched back to a session. */
  var ref=load('trs_ref');
  if(!ref){ ref='JE-'+Math.random().toString(36).slice(2,6).toUpperCase(); store('trs_ref',ref); }
  set('ref',ref);
  document.querySelectorAll('a[href*="wa.me"]').forEach(function(a){
    a.href = a.href + encodeURIComponent(' (ref '+ref+')');
  });

  var svc=q.get('svc'); if(svc){ var s=document.getElementById('svc'); if(s) s.value=svc; }

  /* Layer 4 tags. channel and branch arrive on the URL, because the GBP booking links
     carry ?channel=gbp&branch=<slug> and the four profiles cannot be told apart without
     them. product and emirate derive from her own selections, never typed. */
  set('channel', q.get('channel')||'');
  var urlBranch=q.get('branch')||'';
  set('branch', urlBranch);
  /* offering: uses Emma's exact GHL tag vocabulary so the page feeds her pipeline
     without a translation step. product stays look-vs-door, which is what Layer 4
     measures the conversion on. */
  var OFFERING={smooth:'keratin-smoothing',toner:'toner-reset',treatment:'treatment-blowdry',bundle:'blowdry',
    scalp:'treatment-blowdry',course:'treatment-course'};
  /* branch, in Emma's GHL vocabulary. Her list has no tag for "either Dubai salon", so
     that one is left blank rather than guessed; the salon field still carries her answer. */
  var BRANCH={'khalifa-city':'abudhabi','saadiyat':'abudhabi','either-abudhabi':'abudhabi',
    'al-quoz':'dubai-alquoz','motor-city':'dubai-motorcity'};
  /* Derived fields must CLEAR as well as fill. set() above deliberately ignores an
     empty value, which is right for a UTM that arrives once and must not be wiped by
     a later empty read. It is wrong here: if she picks The Smooth Edit and then
     changes to 'not sure', a sticky set() would send offering:smooth-edit to GHL for
     a woman who told us she does not know. So these three assign unconditionally. */
  var reset=function(n,v){ var el=f.querySelector('[name="'+n+'"]'); if(el) el.value=v; };
  var deriveTags=function(){
    var sv=(document.getElementById('svc')||{}).value||'';
    var sa=(document.getElementById('salon')||{}).value||'';
    reset('product', sv ? (sv==='look'?'look':(sv==='unsure'?'':'door')) : '');
    reset('offering', OFFERING[sv]||'');
    reset('emirate', sa ? ((sa==='al-quoz'||sa==='motor-city'||sa==='either-dubai')?'dubai':'abudhabi') : '');
    /* A GBP link carries ?branch= and wins. Everything else, Instagram, a caption link,
       a stylist's own bio, arrives without one, so her salon choice fills it: Emma's spec
       wants a branch tag on every lead, not only on the ones that came from Google. */
    if(!urlBranch) reset('branch', BRANCH[sa]||'');
  };
  f.addEventListener('change',deriveTags); deriveTags();

  f.addEventListener('submit',function(e){
    e.preventDefault();
    var req=f.querySelectorAll('[required]');
    for(var i=0;i<req.length;i++){
      var el=req[i];
      if((el.type==='checkbox'&&!el.checked)||(el.type!=='checkbox'&&!String(el.value).trim())){ el.focus(); return; }
    }
    var data={};
    f.querySelectorAll('[name]').forEach(function(el){
      if(el.type==='checkbox'){ data[el.name]=el.checked; }
      else if(el.value){ data[el.name]=el.value; }
    });
    if(data.cc&&data.whatsapp){ data.whatsapp=data.cc+' '+data.whatsapp; delete data.cc; }
    if(FORM_ENDPOINT.indexOf("__FORM_ENDPOINT__")===-1){
      try{ fetch(FORM_ENDPOINT,{method:"POST",headers:{"Content-Type":"application/json"},body:JSON.stringify(data)}); }catch(err){}
    }
    var t=document.createElement('div'); t.className='form-thanks';
    t.innerHTML = FORM_ENDPOINT.indexOf('__FORM_ENDPOINT__')===-1
      ? '<h3>Thank you. We have you.</h3><p>We will come back to you on WhatsApp with a time. Your reference is '+ref+'.</p>'
      : '<h3>This is a preview, so nothing was sent.</h3><p>To book now, message your salon on WhatsApp: '+SALON_LINKS+'.</p>';
    f.parentNode.replaceChild(t,f); t.scrollIntoView({behavior:'smooth'});
  });
})();
//-->
</script>
<script>
<!--
/* The submit button looked alive before consent was ticked, so a woman could tap it
   and nothing would happen. Disabled until the form is actually submittable. */
(function(){
  var f=document.querySelector('#book form'); if(!f) return;
  var btn=f.querySelector('button[type=submit]'); if(!btn) return;
  var sync=function(){
    var ok=true;
    f.querySelectorAll('[required]').forEach(function(el){
      if((el.type==='checkbox'&&!el.checked)||(el.type!=='checkbox'&&!String(el.value).trim())) ok=false;
    });
    btn.toggleAttribute('disabled',!ok);
    btn.setAttribute('aria-disabled',String(!ok));
  };
  f.addEventListener('input',sync); f.addEventListener('change',sync); sync();
})();
//-->
</script>
<script>
<!--
document.addEventListener("click",function(e){var a=e.target.closest&&e.target.closest('a[role="button"][href="#"]');if(a)e.preventDefault();});
//-->
</script>
<script>
<!--
(function(){function again(){window.dispatchEvent(new Event("resize"));}if(document.fonts&&document.fonts.load){Promise.all([document.fonts.load('500 26px "HR Playfair Display"'),document.fonts.load('400 26px "HR Playfair Display"'),document.fonts.load('italic 400 26px "HR Playfair Display"'),document.fonts.load('300 16px "HR Inter"')]).then(again,again);}window.addEventListener("load",again);})();
//-->
</script>
<!-- /wp:html -->

<!-- wp:html -->
<style id="hr-styles">
<!--
/* WordPress reset. From the Wellness Voucher build and the components kit (W01). It sits BEFORE the page CSS, at
   element strength, so every page rule still wins over it. It undoes the GeneratePress element styles that would
   otherwise bleed into the page (bare p/ul/blockquote/heading margins, body 15px, container padding). */
body{font-size:16px}
p,h1,h2,h3,h4,h5,h6,ul,ol,li,dl,dd,figure,blockquote,table{margin:0;padding:0;margin-block:0}
h1,h2,h3,h4,h5,h6{font-family:inherit;font-weight:bold;line-height:inherit;color:inherit;text-transform:none;letter-spacing:normal}
h1{font-size:2em}h2{font-size:1.5em}h3{font-size:1.17em}h4{font-size:1em}h5{font-size:.83em}h6{font-size:.67em}
blockquote{border:0;font-size:inherit;font-style:normal;position:static}
button{padding:0;font:revert;color:revert;letter-spacing:revert;text-transform:revert;line-height:revert}
.site-content,.content-area,.site-main,.inside-article,.entry-content,.site.grid-container,.container.grid-container{padding:0!important;margin:0!important;max-width:none!important;width:100%!important;float:none!important}
.entry-header,.page-header,.post-image,.featured-image{display:none!important}
body{-webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased;-moz-osx-font-smoothing:grayscale;text-rendering:optimizeLegibility;letter-spacing:normal}
table,td,th{border:0}
/* GeneratePress gives form controls the theme font and a 24px line-height; the review page left them at the browser default. */
input,select,textarea{font:revert;line-height:revert;letter-spacing:revert;color:revert}
/* WordPress's Details block adds a block gap between its parts (is-layout-flow). The review page has none. */
details.wp-block-details>*{margin-block-start:0;margin-block-end:0}

@font-face{font-family:'HR Inter';font-style:normal;font-weight:300 600;font-display:swap;src:url(https://www.tararosesalon.com/wp-content/themes/tara-rose-salon/assets/ae/fonts/inter-300.woff2) format('woff2')}
@font-face{font-family:'HR Playfair Display';font-style:normal;font-weight:400;font-display:swap;src:url(https://www.tararosesalon.com/wp-content/uploads/generatepress/fonts/playfair-display/PlayfairDisplay-Regular.woff2) format('woff2')}
@font-face{font-family:'HR Playfair Display';font-style:normal;font-weight:500;font-display:swap;src:url(https://www.tararosesalon.com/wp-content/themes/tara-rose-salon/assets/ae/fonts/playfair-display-500.woff2) format('woff2')}
@font-face{font-family:'HR Playfair Display';font-style:italic;font-weight:400 500;font-display:swap;src:url(https://www.tararosesalon.com/wp-content/themes/tara-rose-salon/assets/ae/fonts/playfair-display-500-italic.woff2) format('woff2')}
:where(.hr-run,.hr-loose){display:contents}
div:where(.hr-small){display:inline;font-size:smaller}
div:where(.hr-strong){display:inline;font-weight:bolder}

/* css/voucher-base.css */
:root{--paper:#FAF8F4; --cream:#F1ECE3; --stone-soft:#EFEBE3; --stone:#E7E2D8; --sand:#E7DFD2;
  --ink:#2D2E37; --ink-deep:#1C1B18; --ink-soft:#74747B; --hair:rgba(45,46,55,.11);
  --accent:#99F6E4; --accent-deep:#7DE6D2; --accent-text:#1C7563; --accent-soft:#EEF3C7;
  --lime:#EEF3C7; --lavender:#C4B5FD; --coral:#FF9B9B; --err:#C9685F;
  --r-lg:22px; --r-md:16px; --r-sm:14px; --r-pill:100px;
  --ease:cubic-bezier(.22,.61,.36,1); --dur:.3s;
  --fd:"HR Playfair Display",Georgia,serif; --fb:"HR Inter",system-ui,-apple-system,sans-serif;
  --maxw:1180px; --pad-x:26px; --sec-y:96px;}
@media (max-width:900px){:root{--sec-y:64px;}}
@media (max-width:600px){:root{--sec-y:48px; --pad-x:20px;}}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){*,*::before,*::after{animation-duration:.01ms!important; transition-duration:.01ms!important;}}
*,*::before,*::after{margin:0; padding:0; box-sizing:border-box;}
html{scroll-behavior:smooth;}
body{font-family:var(--fb); color:var(--ink); background:var(--paper); line-height:1.62; -webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased; -moz-osx-font-smoothing:grayscale; text-rendering:optimizeLegibility; font-feature-settings:"kern","liga","calt"; overflow-x:hidden;}
h1,h2,h3,h4{font-optical-sizing:auto;}
img{max-width:100%; display:block;}
a{color:inherit; text-decoration:none;}
.wrap{max-width:var(--maxw); margin:0 auto; padding:0 var(--pad-x);}
section{padding:var(--sec-y) 0;}
.skip{position:absolute; top:-100px; left:16px; z-index:999; background:var(--ink); color:var(--paper); padding:12px 20px; border-radius:var(--r-pill); font-family:var(--fb); font-size:13px; font-weight:500;}
.skip:focus{top:12px;}
:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--accent-text); outline-offset:3px; border-radius:3px;}
.hr-eyebrow{font-family:var(--fb); font-size:11px; font-weight:500; letter-spacing:.4em; text-transform:uppercase; color:var(--ink-soft);}
.hr-h-1{font-family:var(--fd); font-weight:500; font-size:clamp(42px,min(6.2vw,9vh),80px); line-height:1.0; letter-spacing:-.018em; text-wrap:balance;}
.hr-pill{display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:10px; font-family:var(--fb); font-size:13px; font-weight:500; letter-spacing:.04em; padding:14px 26px; border-radius:var(--r-pill); border:none; cursor:pointer; text-decoration:none; background:var(--ink); color:var(--paper); transition:transform var(--dur) var(--ease),background var(--dur) var(--ease),box-shadow var(--dur) var(--ease); box-shadow:0 1px 2px rgba(45,46,55,.10);}
.hr-pill:hover{transform:translateY(-2px); background:#3b3c47; box-shadow:0 11px 24px -10px rgba(45,46,55,.42);}
.pill--accent{background:var(--accent); color:var(--ink); box-shadow:0 1px 2px rgba(61,140,127,.20);}
.pill--accent:hover{background:var(--accent-deep); box-shadow:0 12px 26px -10px rgba(61,140,127,.5);}
.trs-nav{position:sticky; top:0; z-index:60; background:rgba(250,248,244,.86); backdrop-filter:blur(12px); -webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(12px); border-bottom:1px solid var(--hair); transition:box-shadow .4s var(--ease),background .4s var(--ease);}
.trs-nav .navrow{display:grid; grid-template-columns:1fr auto 1fr; align-items:center; height:74px;}
.trs-nav .brand{display:flex; flex-direction:column; align-items:center; line-height:1; justify-self:center; padding:0 clamp(18px,2.6vw,44px);}
.trs-nav .brand__tick{width:34px; height:2px; background:var(--accent-deep); margin-bottom:8px;}
.trs-nav .brand__wm{font-family:var(--fd); font-weight:500; font-size:21px; letter-spacing:.32em; color:var(--ink);}
.trs-nav .brand :is(small,div:where(.hr-small),span:where(.hr-small)){display:block; font-family:var(--fb); font-weight:500; font-size:8.5px; letter-spacing:.44em; color:var(--ink-soft); margin-top:5px; text-align:center;}
.trs-nav .nav__cta{justify-self:start; padding:11px 20px; font-size:12px;}
.trs-nav .nav-link{justify-self:end; font-family:var(--fb); font-size:11.5px; font-weight:600; letter-spacing:.16em; text-transform:uppercase; color:var(--ink-soft);}
.trs-nav .nav-link:hover{color:var(--ink);}
@media (max-width:600px){.trs-nav .nav-link{display:none;}.trs-nav .nav__cta{font-size:11px; padding:10px 16px;}.trs-nav .brand__wm{font-size:18px;}}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion:no-preference){@keyframes pulse{ 0%,100%{ box-shadow:0 0 0 0 rgba(153,246,228,.5) } 50%{ box-shadow:0 0 0 7px rgba(153,246,228,0) } }}
.hr-dark{background:var(--ink-deep); color:#fff;}
.hr-dark .hr-eyebrow{color:rgba(255,255,255,.55);}
.hr-dark h2,.hr-dark h3{color:#fff;}
.hr-sec-head{max-width:640px; margin-bottom:44px;}
.hr-sec-head .hr-eyebrow{display:block; margin-bottom:14px;}
.hr-sec-head h2{font-family:var(--fd); font-weight:500; font-size:clamp(31px,4.4vw,52px); line-height:1.05; letter-spacing:-.012em; color:var(--ink); text-wrap:balance;}
.hr-dark .hr-sec-head h2{color:#fff;}
.hr-grid-3{display:grid; grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr); gap:20px;}
@media (max-width:860px){.hr-grid-3{grid-template-columns:1fr;}}
.foot{background:#161512; color:#fff; padding:84px 0 32px;}
.foot .row{display:grid; grid-template-columns:1.4fr 1fr 1fr; gap:48px; padding-bottom:42px; border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.1);}
.foot h4{font-family:var(--fb); font-size:11px; font-weight:600; letter-spacing:.24em; text-transform:uppercase; color:rgba(255,255,255,.55); margin-bottom:18px;}
.foot p,.foot a{font-family:var(--fb); font-size:13.5px; color:rgba(255,255,255,.72); line-height:1.72; font-weight:300;}
.foot a:hover{color:#fff;}
.foot .brand__wm{font-family:var(--fd); font-weight:500; font-size:24px; letter-spacing:.28em; color:#fff; margin-bottom:6px; display:block;}
.foot .sig{font-family:var(--fd); font-style:italic; color:var(--accent); font-size:16px; margin-top:22px; display:block;}
.foot__legal{padding:20px 0; border-top:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.1); color:rgba(255,255,255,.55); font-size:12px; line-height:1.7; margin-top:24px;}
.foot__legal a{color:rgba(255,255,255,.72); text-decoration:underline;}
.foot .subrow{padding-top:24px; display:flex; justify-content:space-between; color:rgba(255,255,255,.5); font-size:11.5px; letter-spacing:.06em;}

outline:none;}
input::placeholder,textarea::placeholder{color:var(--taupe-soft)}
input[type=checkbox]{min-height:0; padding:0}
body{overflow-x:clip}
.trs-nav .nav__cta{min-height:44px; padding:13px 20px}
img,svg,video,table,pre{max-width:100%}
input[type=checkbox],input[type=radio]{appearance:none; -webkit-appearance:none;
flex:0 0 auto; width:22px; height:22px; min-height:22px; margin:0;
border:1.5px solid rgba(45,46,55,.30);
background:#fff;
box-shadow:inset 0 1px 2px rgba(28,26,22,.05);
cursor:pointer; position:relative;
transition:border-color .18s var(--ease), background .18s var(--ease), box-shadow .18s var(--ease);}
input[type=checkbox]{border-radius:6px}
input[type=radio]{border-radius:50%}
input[type=checkbox]:hover,input[type=radio]:hover{border-color:var(--accent-text)}
input[type=checkbox]:checked,input[type=radio]:checked{background-image:linear-gradient(178deg, var(--accent-lift), var(--accent-drop));
border-color:rgba(14,42,37,.30);
box-shadow:inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.5), 0 1px 2px rgba(14,42,37,.18);}
input[type=checkbox]:checked::after{content:""; position:absolute; left:7.5px; top:3.5px;
width:5px; height:10px;
border:solid var(--on-accent); border-width:0 2px 2px 0;
transform:rotate(45deg);}
input[type=radio]:checked::after{content:""; position:absolute; inset:5px;
border-radius:50%; background:var(--on-accent);}
input[type=checkbox]:focus-visible,input[type=radio]:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--accent-dark); outline-offset:2px;}
label:has(input[type=checkbox]),label:has(input[type=radio]){display:flex; align-items:flex-start; gap:12px;
min-height:52px; padding:13px 16px;
border:1px solid var(--hair); border-radius:var(--r-sm);
background:var(--paper);
box-shadow:var(--rim-light), var(--sh-subtle-sm);
cursor:pointer; font-size:15px; line-height:1.45;
transition:border-color .18s var(--ease), background .18s var(--ease), box-shadow .18s var(--ease);}
label:has(input[type=checkbox]):hover,label:has(input[type=radio]):hover{border-color:var(--accent-text);
box-shadow:var(--rim-light), var(--sh-reg-sm);}
label:has(input:checked){border-color:var(--accent-text);
background:linear-gradient(178deg, #FFFFFF, #F2FCF9);
box-shadow:var(--rim-light), 0 0 0 1px rgba(58,168,146,.28), var(--sh-reg-sm);}
.hr-pill:active{transform:translateY(0);
box-shadow:inset 0 2px 5px rgba(14,42,37,.22), 0 1px 1px rgba(14,42,37,.10);}
.hr-pill:disabled,.hr-pill[aria-disabled=true],button:disabled{background-image:none !important;
background-color:var(--disabled) !important;
color:var(--taupe-soft) !important;
border-color:rgba(45,46,55,.10) !important;
box-shadow:none !important;
transform:none !important;
cursor:not-allowed;
pointer-events:auto;}
.hr-pill:disabled:hover,button:disabled:hover{background-color:var(--disabled) !important; transform:none !important; box-shadow:none !important;}
@keyframes trs-spin{ to{ transform:rotate(360deg) } }
.hr-dark .pill--accent:disabled,.trs-nav .nav__cta:disabled,button.hr-pill:disabled{background-color:var(--disabled) !important;
background-image:none !important;
color:var(--taupe-soft) !important;
border-color:rgba(45,46,55,.10) !important;
box-shadow:none !important;}
input,select,textarea{font-size:16px}
.hr-pill,button.hr-pill{line-height:1;
padding-block:0;
height:52px;
display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center;}
.trs-nav .nav__cta{height:44px; padding:0 20px}
.hr-pill{padding-inline:32px}
.hr-grid-3 > *{min-width:0}
:focus-visible{outline:none;
box-shadow:0 0 0 2px var(--color-canvas), 0 0 0 4px var(--color-accent-strong);
border-radius:4px;}
.hr-dark :focus-visible{box-shadow:0 0 0 2px var(--ink-deep), 0 0 0 4px var(--color-accent);}
.pill--accent{background-image:linear-gradient(178deg, var(--accent-lift) 0%, var(--accent-mid) 52%, var(--accent-drop) 100%)!important;
background-color:var(--accent-mid)!important;
color:var(--on-accent)!important;
border:1px solid rgba(14,42,37,.22)!important;
box-shadow:var(--sh-rim-light), 0 1px 2px rgba(14,42,37,.16), 0 12px 26px -10px rgba(14,42,37,.42)!important;}
.pill--accent:hover{background-image:linear-gradient(178deg, var(--accent-lift-h) 0%, var(--accent-mid-h) 52%, var(--accent-drop-h) 100%)!important;}
.pill--accent:disabled,button.pill--accent:disabled{background-image:none!important; background-color:var(--disabled)!important;
color:var(--taupe-soft)!important; border-color:rgba(45,46,55,.10)!important;
box-shadow:none!important;}
.trs-nav .nav__cta{white-space:nowrap; padding:0 18px}
input,select,textarea,input[type="text"],input[type="email"],input[type="tel"]{font-size: 16px !important;}
.navrow:has(> .nav__cta):has(> .nav-link) > .nav-link{order:1; justify-self:start}
.navrow:has(> .nav__cta):has(> .nav-link) > .brand{order:2}
.navrow:has(> .nav__cta):has(> .nav-link) > .nav__cta{order:3; justify-self:end}
@media (min-width:1025px){.trs-nav .wrap.navrow{max-width:min(1420px, 100% - 48px)}.navrow > *{min-width:0}.navrow:has(> .nav__zone-l){grid-template-columns:auto 1fr auto; column-gap:32px}.navrow:has(> .nav__zone-l) > .brand{order:1; justify-self:start;
padding-left:0; padding-right:0}}
.trs-nav{position:sticky; top:0; z-index:60;
background:color-mix(in srgb, var(--canvas) 88%, transparent);
backdrop-filter:blur(12px); -webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(12px);
border-bottom:1px solid var(--hairline);
transition:box-shadow .4s var(--ease), background .4s var(--ease);}
.trs-nav .brand{display:inline-flex; flex-direction:column; align-items:center;
text-decoration:none; font-style:normal; line-height:1;}
.trs-nav .brand__tick{width:34px; height:2px; border-radius:0;
background:var(--accent-dark, var(--accent)); margin:0 0 8px;}
.trs-nav .brand__wm{font-family:var(--ff-display); font-weight:500; font-style:normal;
font-size:19px; letter-spacing:.3em; color:var(--ink);
white-space:nowrap;}
.trs-nav .brand :is(small,div:where(.hr-small),span:where(.hr-small)){display:block; margin-top:5px;
font-family:var(--ff-body); font-style:normal; font-weight:500;
font-size:9.5px; letter-spacing:.22em; text-transform:uppercase;
color:var(--taupe); white-space:nowrap;}
@media (max-width:560px){.navrow:has(> .nav__cta):has(> .nav-link){grid-template-columns:1fr auto; column-gap:12px}.navrow:has(> .nav__cta):has(> .nav-link) > .nav-link{display:none}.navrow:has(> .nav__cta):has(> .nav-link) > .brand{justify-self:start}.navrow:has(> .nav__cta):has(> .nav-link) > .nav__cta{justify-self:end}.navrow:has(> .nav__cta):has(> .nav-link) > .brand .brand__wm{font-size:16px; letter-spacing:.2em}.navrow:has(> .nav__cta):has(> .nav-link) > .nav__cta{font-size:10px; padding-inline:13px; letter-spacing:.06em}}
@media (min-width:1025px){.navrow:has(> .nav-links){grid-template-columns:auto 1fr auto; column-gap:30px}.navrow:has(> .nav-links) > .brand{order:1; justify-self:start; padding-inline:0}.navrow:has(> .nav-links) > .nav__cta{order:3; justify-self:end}}
@media (min-width:561px){.navrow:has(> .nav__cta):has(> .nav-link){display:flex; align-items:center; gap:24px}.navrow:has(> .nav__cta):has(> .nav-link) > .brand{order:1; margin-right:auto; justify-self:start}.navrow:has(> .nav__cta):has(> .nav-link) > .nav-link{order:2}.navrow:has(> .nav__cta):has(> .nav-link) > .nav__cta{order:3}}
@media (min-width:768px) and (max-width:1024px){.navrow:has(> .nav__zone-l){grid-template-columns:auto 1fr; column-gap:16px}.navrow:has(> .nav__zone-l) > .brand{order:1; justify-self:start; padding-inline:0}}
.skip{position:absolute;left:-9999px;top:0;z-index:200;background:var(--ink);color:#fff;
padding:12px 20px;border-radius:0 0 10px 0;font-family:var(--ff-body);font-size:14px;font-weight:500}
.skip:focus{left:0}

.soc[href*="instagram"],.soc[href*="facebook"],.soc[href*="linkedin"],.soc[href*="youtube"],.soc[href*="tiktok"],.soc[href*="spotify"]{display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:9px;}

/* css/the-hair-rhythm.css */
.trs-nav .brand__wm{font-family:var(--fb); font-weight:400;}
.foot .brand__wm{font-family:var(--fb); font-weight:400;}
.hr-eyebrow{font-size:12.5px; letter-spacing:.3em;}
.trs-nav .nav-link{font-size:12.5px;}
body{overflow-x:clip;}
/* inline 0 */
.thead{padding:72px 0 64px;text-align:center}
.thead .hr-eyebrow{display:block;margin-bottom:14px}
.thead h1{font-family:var(--fd);font-weight:500;font-size:clamp(36px,6.4vw,60px);line-height:1.05;letter-spacing:-.012em;color:#fff;margin:0}
.thead h1 em{color:var(--accent)}
.thead .tlede{max-width:56ch;margin:20px auto 0;font-family:var(--fb);font-size:16.5px;font-weight:300;line-height:1.65;color:rgba(255,255,255,.82)}
.thead .tmicro{margin-top:22px;font-family:var(--fb);font-size:12px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--accent)}
.tback{display:inline-block;margin-top:26px;font-family:var(--fb);font-size:13.5px;font-weight:500;color:#fff;text-decoration:underline;text-underline-offset:4px}
.tsec{background:var(--paper);padding:56px 0 76px}
.tcol{max-width:720px;margin:0 auto;padding:0 20px}
ol.clauses{list-style:none;counter-reset:t;margin:0;padding:0}
ol.clauses>li{counter-increment:t;position:relative;padding:54px 0 30px;margin:0 0 30px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--hair);font-family:var(--fb);font-size:15px;font-weight:300;line-height:1.72;color:var(--ink-soft)}
ol.clauses>li:last-child{border-bottom:0;margin-bottom:0}
ol.clauses>li::before{content:counter(t);position:absolute;left:0;top:0;width:38px;height:38px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--paper);border:1px solid var(--hair);box-shadow:0 1px 2px rgba(45,46,55,.05),0 10px 22px -14px rgba(45,46,55,.22);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-family:var(--fb);font-weight:600;font-size:15px;color:var(--accent-text)}
ol.clauses>li :is(strong,div:where(.hr-strong),span:where(.hr-strong)).th{display:block;font-family:var(--fd);font-weight:500;font-size:24px;line-height:1.2;color:var(--ink);margin-bottom:10px}
ol.clauses>li p{margin:0 0 10px}
ol.clauses>li p:last-child{margin-bottom:0}
ol.clauses>li a{color:var(--accent-text)}
.tscroll{overflow-x:auto;margin:16px 0 14px;border:1px solid var(--hair);border-radius:var(--r-md);background:var(--stone-soft)}
.tscroll table{width:100%;border-collapse:collapse;font-size:14px;line-height:1.45}
.tscroll th{padding:12px 14px;text-align:left;font-family:var(--fb);font-size:10.5px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.12em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--ink-soft);border-bottom:1px solid var(--hair);white-space:nowrap}
.tscroll td{padding:12px 14px;color:var(--ink);border-top:1px solid var(--hair);vertical-align:top}
.tscroll tr:first-child td{border-top:0}
.tscroll td b{font-weight:600}
.promise-q{margin:14px 0 0;padding:16px 18px;border-left:3px solid var(--accent-deep);background:var(--stone-soft);border-radius:0 var(--r-sm) var(--r-sm) 0;font-family:var(--fd);font-size:19px;line-height:1.45;color:var(--ink)}
@media (max-width:560px){.thead{padding:52px 0 48px}ol.clauses>li{font-size:14.5px;padding-top:48px;padding-bottom:24px;margin-bottom:24px}ol.clauses>li::before{width:34px;height:34px;font-size:14px}ol.clauses>li :is(strong,div:where(.hr-strong),span:where(.hr-strong)).th{font-size:21px}.tscroll th,.tscroll td{padding:10px 11px}.promise-q{font-size:17px}}
@media (max-width:480px){.trs-nav .nav-link{display:none}.trs-nav .navrow{grid-template-columns:1fr auto 1fr}.trs-nav .nav__cta{padding-inline:14px;font-size:9.5px;letter-spacing:.06em;white-space:nowrap}.trs-nav .brand{padding:0 6px}.trs-nav .brand__wm{font-size:15px;letter-spacing:.18em}}
@media (max-width:380px){.trs-nav .nav__cta{padding-inline:10px;font-size:8.5px;letter-spacing:.04em;min-height:38px}.trs-nav .brand__wm{font-size:13px;letter-spacing:.14em}.trs-nav .brand :is(small,div:where(.hr-small),span:where(.hr-small)){font-size:8px}.trs-nav .brand{padding:0 4px}}
@media (max-width:380px){.trs-nav .navrow{padding-inline:12px}.trs-nav .nav__cta{padding-inline:8px;font-size:8px;letter-spacing:.03em}.trs-nav .brand__wm{font-size:12px;letter-spacing:.12em}}
@media (max-width:480px){html body .trs-nav .nav__cta{font-size:12px !important;letter-spacing:.04em;padding-inline:16px;min-height:42px}html body .trs-nav .nav__cta .nb{display:none}}
-->

<!-- wp:generateblocks/text {"uniqueId":"218e70df","tagName":"p","className":"tlede"} -->
<p class="gb-text tlede">These terms apply to The Hair Rhythm, available at all four Tara Rose salons: Khalifa City A and Mamsha Al Saadiyat in Abu Dhabi, Al Quoz 1 and Motor City in Dubai.</p>

<!-- wp:generateblocks/element {"uniqueId":"1d7701a2","tagName":"section","className":"tsec"} -->
<section class="tsec"><!-- wp:generateblocks/element {"uniqueId":"9e5a03f9","tagName":"div","className":"tcol"} -->
<div class="tcol"><!-- wp:generateblocks/element {"uniqueId":"b174dac7","tagName":"ol","className":"clauses"} -->
<ol class="clauses"><!-- wp:generateblocks/element {"uniqueId":"eae3c451","tagName":"li"} -->
<li><!-- wp:generateblocks/element {"uniqueId":"cbe1db3c","tagName":"div","className":"th hr-strong"} -->
<div class="th hr-strong"><!-- wp:generateblocks/text {"uniqueId":"8d5077be","tagName":"span","className":"hr-loose"} -->
<span class="gb-text hr-loose">Where it applies.</span>
<!-- /wp:generateblocks/text --></div>
<!-- /wp:generateblocks/element -->

<!-- wp:generateblocks/text {"uniqueId":"6be6b932","tagName":"p"} -->
<p class="gb-text">The Hair Rhythm is available at all four Tara Rose salons: Khalifa City A and Mamsha Al Saadiyat in Abu Dhabi, Al Quoz 1 and Motor City in Dubai.</p>
<!-- /wp:generateblocks/text --></li>
<!-- /wp:generateblocks/element -->

<!-- wp:generateblocks/element {"uniqueId":"525b784e","tagName":"li"} -->
<li><!-- wp:generateblocks/element {"uniqueId":"755f76ee","tagName":"div","className":"th hr-strong"} -->
<div class="th hr-strong"><!-- wp:generateblocks/text {"uniqueId":"92b3a81b","tagName":"span","className":"hr-loose"} -->
<span class="gb-text hr-loose">How prices work.</span>
<!-- /wp:generateblocks/text --></div>
<!-- /wp:generateblocks/element -->

<!-- wp:generateblocks/text {"uniqueId":"2d4a109c","tagName":"p"} -->
<p class="gb-text">Every price shown is a starting price for short or fine hair, in AED.</p>
<!-- /wp:generateblocks/text -->

<!-- wp:generateblocks/text {"uniqueId":"820f0154","tagName":"p"} -->
<p class="gb-text">Prices shown are guide prices. Your salon confirms the final price for your length and thickness. Colour maintenance is priced the same way, by your hair length.</p>
<!-- /wp:generateblocks/text --></li>
<!-- /wp:generateblocks/element -->

<!-- wp:generateblocks/element {"uniqueId":"0533a862","tagName":"li"} -->
<li><!-- wp:generateblocks/element {"uniqueId":"0590cbc7","tagName":"div","className":"th hr-strong"} -->
<div class="th hr-strong"><!-- wp:generateblocks/text {"uniqueId":"8397e8ff","tagName":"span","className":"hr-loose"} -->
<span class="gb-text hr-loose">Prepaid packages.</span>
<!-- /wp:generateblocks/text --></div>
<!-- /wp:generateblocks/element -->

<!-- wp:generateblocks/text {"uniqueId":"8ed12816","tagName":"p"} -->
<p class="gb-text">The Blow-dry Edit, the Blow-dry Series, Four Weeks of Blow-dries and Treatment Courses are paid once and booked with your salon as you need them, at any of the four salons. We do our best to keep you with the same stylist.</p>
<!-- /wp:generateblocks/text -->

<!-- wp:generateblocks/text {"uniqueId":"ff69e7c5","tagName":"p"} -->
<p class="gb-text">Four Weeks of Blow-dries is two blow-dries a week across four weeks, with the slots held in advance.</p>
<!-- /wp:generateblocks/text --></li>
<!-- /wp:generateblocks/element -->

<!-- wp:generateblocks/element {"uniqueId":"76f8423a","tagName":"li"} -->
<li><!-- wp:generateblocks/element {"uniqueId":"6f450c7f","tagName":"div","className":"th hr-strong"} -->
<div class="th hr-strong"><!-- wp:generateblocks/text {"uniqueId":"7380a863","tagName":"span","className":"hr-loose"} -->
<span class="gb-text hr-loose">Who it is for and what is not included.</span>
<!-- /wp:generateblocks/text --></div>
<!-- /wp:generateblocks/element -->

<!-- wp:generateblocks/text {"uniqueId":"f44c8177","tagName":"p"} -->
<p class="gb-text">The Hair Rhythm prices apply to our junior stylists and stylists. Senior stylists and style directors are not part of The Hair Rhythm, and their services are priced separately.</p>
<!-- /wp:generateblocks/text -->

<!-- wp:generateblocks/text {"uniqueId":"0418961f","tagName":"p"} -->
<p class="gb-text">Colour maintenance is not available for bleach, scalp bleach, platinum, maximum brightness or anything that needs bleaching. If your hair is bleached, please book a consultation first. A toner after a root colour is booked on its own, at its regular price.</p>
<!-- /wp:generateblocks/text --></li>
<!-- /wp:generateblocks/element -->

<!-- wp:generateblocks/element {"uniqueId":"35c1028d","tagName":"li"} -->
<li><!-- wp:generateblocks/element {"uniqueId":"341d6e35","tagName":"div","className":"th hr-strong"} -->
<div class="th hr-strong"><!-- wp:generateblocks/text {"uniqueId":"ade303f4","tagName":"span","className":"hr-loose"} -->
<span class="gb-text hr-loose">Paying.</span>
<!-- /wp:generateblocks/text --></div>
<!-- /wp:generateblocks/element -->

<!-- wp:generateblocks/text {"uniqueId":"03310f63","tagName":"p"} -->
<p class="gb-text">Your salon replies on WhatsApp during salon hours, 9am to 8pm, with your price and a secure payment link.</p>
<!-- /wp:generateblocks/text --></li>
<!-- /wp:generateblocks/element -->

<!-- wp:generateblocks/element {"uniqueId":"f76e9248","tagName":"li"} -->
<li><!-- wp:generateblocks/element {"uniqueId":"90f81901","tagName":"div","className":"th hr-strong"} -->
<div class="th hr-strong"><!-- wp:generateblocks/text {"uniqueId":"778d8c1e","tagName":"span","className":"hr-loose"} -->
<span class="gb-text hr-loose">How long they last.</span>
<!-- /wp:generateblocks/text --></div>

<p class="gb-text">Sessions not used by then expire.</p>
<!-- /wp:generateblocks/text --></li>
<!-- /wp:generateblocks/element -->

<!-- wp:generateblocks/element {"uniqueId":"a728eec7","tagName":"li"} -->
<li><!-- wp:generateblocks/element {"uniqueId":"0d26449b","tagName":"div","className":"th hr-strong"} -->
<div class="th hr-strong"><!-- wp:generateblocks/text {"uniqueId":"fbe64720","tagName":"span","className":"hr-loose"} -->
<span class="gb-text hr-loose">December and public holidays.</span>
<!-- /wp:generateblocks/text --></div>
<!-- /wp:generateblocks/element -->

<!-- wp:generateblocks/text {"uniqueId":"ff6403a5","tagName":"p"} -->
<p class="gb-text">Prepaid sessions cannot be booked in December or on a public holiday.</p>
<!-- /wp:generateblocks/text -->

<!-- wp:generateblocks/text {"uniqueId":"041c8e65","tagName":"p"} -->
<p class="gb-text">The days of December and the public holidays that fall inside your validity do not count against it. Your validity is extended by those days, so you do not lose a session to them.</p>
<!-- /wp:generateblocks/text --></li>
<!-- /wp:generateblocks/element -->

<!-- wp:generateblocks/element {"uniqueId":"9193f6b7","tagName":"li"} -->
<li><!-- wp:generateblocks/element {"uniqueId":"d1a4837c","tagName":"div","className":"th hr-strong"} -->
<div class="th hr-strong"><!-- wp:generateblocks/text {"uniqueId":"f61bacfe","tagName":"span","className":"hr-loose"} -->
<span class="gb-text hr-loose">Refunds and missed appointments.</span>
<!-- /wp:generateblocks/text --></div>
<!-- /wp:generateblocks/element -->

<!-- wp:generateblocks/text {"uniqueId":"4db4fc8a","tagName":"p"} -->
<p class="gb-text">Prepaid sessions are not refundable.</p>
<!-- /wp:generateblocks/text -->

<!-- wp:generateblocks/text {"uniqueId":"6b84f887","tagName":"p"} -->
<p class="gb-text">An appointment missed without 48 hours’ notice counts as a used session.</p>
<!-- /wp:generateblocks/text --></li>
<!-- /wp:generateblocks/element -->

<!-- wp:generateblocks/element {"uniqueId":"c35565c1","tagName":"li"} -->
<li><!-- wp:generateblocks/element {"uniqueId":"27606c39","tagName":"div","className":"th hr-strong"} -->

<!-- /wp:generateblocks/text --></div>
<!-- /wp:generateblocks/element -->

<!-- wp:generateblocks/text {"uniqueId":"ec12abd4","tagName":"p"} -->
<p class="gb-text">The Hair Rhythm cannot be combined with other offers or vouchers.</p>
<!-- /wp:generateblocks/text --></li>
<!-- /wp:generateblocks/element -->

<!-- wp:generateblocks/element {"uniqueId":"819298fa","tagName":"li"} -->
<li><!-- wp:generateblocks/element {"uniqueId":"8def1976","tagName":"div","className":"th hr-strong"} -->
<div class="th hr-strong"><!-- wp:generateblocks/text {"uniqueId":"4fa287b1","tagName":"span","className":"hr-loose"} -->
<span class="gb-text hr-loose">Moving an appointment.</span>
<!-- /wp:generateblocks/text --></div>
<!-- /wp:generateblocks/element -->

<!-- wp:generateblocks/text {"uniqueId":"714bec37","tagName":"p"} -->
<p class="gb-text">We ask for 48 hours’ notice to move or cancel an appointment. Short notice follows our <a href="https://www.tararosesalon.com/en/ae/deposit-policy/" target="_blank" rel="noopener">booking and deposit policy</a>.</p>
<!-- /wp:generateblocks/text --></li>
<!-- /wp:generateblocks/element -->

<!-- wp:generateblocks/element {"uniqueId":"59bfbbbb","tagName":"li"} -->
<li><!-- wp:generateblocks/element {"uniqueId":"5c6cdd06","tagName":"div","className":"th hr-strong"} -->
<div class="th hr-strong"><!-- wp:generateblocks/text {"uniqueId":"42d6c4c2","tagName":"span","className":"hr-loose"} -->
<span class="gb-text hr-loose">Deposits.</span>
<!-- /wp:generateblocks/text --></div>
<!-- /wp:generateblocks/element -->

<!-- wp:generateblocks/text {"uniqueId":"50370ad6","tagName":"p"} -->
<p class="gb-text">Some appointments need a deposit to hold your time, such as a longer or higher-value service, or any appointment of more than two hours. We tell you before anything is confirmed.</p>

<!-- wp:generateblocks/text {"uniqueId":"0cd26914","tagName":"h2","styles":{},"htmlAttributes":{"id":"faq-h"}} --> <h2 class="gb-text" id="faq-h">Keratin & Smoothing, answered.</h2> <!-- /wp:generateblocks/text --></div> <!-- /wp:generateblocks/element -->
<!-- wp:html --> <details class="tr-q"><summary>What is Keratin & Smoothing?<span class="chev"></span></summary><div class="ans">It is a salon service that coats each strand and seals the outer layer of your hair with heat. Humid air has less to grab onto, so frizz stays down, your hair dries faster and it stays smooth for months, not hours.</div></details> <details class="tr-q"><summary>How long does a keratin treatment last?<span class="chev"></span></summary><div class="ans">Up to around six months. It softens gradually as you wash, and a sulphate-free shampoo helps it last. Many clients add a Keratin Regrowth Touch-Up at three to four months, which smooths the new growth so they never start again from zero.</div></details> <details class="tr-q"><summary>How long does a keratin smoothing appointment take?<span class="chev"></span></summary><div class="ans">Allow two to four hours. Longer and thicker hair takes longer, and your salon confirms the time for your hair when you book.</div></details> <details class="tr-q"><summary>Keratin Frizz-Free or Keratin Supreme, which one is right for me?<span class="chev"></span></summary><div class="ans">Choose Frizz-Free if you want to keep body and movement, and Supreme Straightening if you want your hair sleek and straight. If you are not sure, your stylist looks at your hair on your WhatsApp consultation and tells you which one suits it.</div></details> <details class="tr-q"><summary>How much does keratin smoothing cost in Dubai and Abu Dhabi?<span class="chev"></span></summary><div class="ans">At Tara Rose it starts at AED 1,085 for short hair, AED 1,285 for medium, AED 1,400 for long and AED 1,600 for extra long. REVISED (Tara, 14 Jul): the first pass stripped turquoise off the label layer
and it went austere. The discipline is right for PROSE - body copy in a warm

.jr-open{ text-align:center; padding:clamp(48px,7vw,86px) 0 clamp(30px,4vw,44px); }

.jr-quote{ display:block; font-family:var(--ff-display); font-style:italic; font-size:46px; line-height:.5;

.jr-turn{ margin:0; font-family:var(--ff-display); font-weight:500; font-style:italic;

.jr-h2{ margin:0 0 30px; text-align:center; font-family:var(--ff-display); font-weight:500;
