.press-quote{ margin:22px auto 0; max-width:48ch; font-family:var(--ff-body); font-style:normal;
font-size:19px; font-weight:300; line-height:1.55; color:var(--ink); }
.press-quote::before{ content:"\201C"; display:block; font-family:var(--ff-display);
font-size:44px; line-height:.6; color:var(--accent-text); margin-bottom:10px; }
.press-quote span{ display:block; margin-top:9px; font-family:var(--ff-body); font-style:normal; font-size:10.5px; letter-spacing:.14em; text-transform:uppercase; color:var(--ink-soft); }
.go, .nav-link, .stepgo{
display:inline-flex; align-items:center; min-height:24px; }
@media (max-width:834px){
.go, .nav-link, .stepgo{ min-height:44px; } }
input[type="checkbox"], input[type="radio"],
.pdpl__checkbox, .check__box{ min-width:24px; min-height:24px; }
.foot p > a:only-child, .foot .soc, .subrow a{
display:inline-flex; align-items:center; min-height:24px; }
@media (max-width:520px){
.mtop{ flex-wrap:wrap; row-gap:4px; }
.mname{ white-space:normal; }
.mtop .mdots{ display:none; }
.mprice{ margin-left:0; }
}
.inc, .loc, .cred, .teach, .circle, .bcard, .tier, .tcard, .tcard-x,
.pkg, .lcard, .gcard, .acard, .card, .visit-card, .stage, .rhythm,
.path, .col, .item, .receives, .exp-tile, .gscores li, .award{
border: 1px solid var(--hair);
}
.wv-dark .inc, .wv-dark .acard, .wv-dark .card, .wv-dark .stage, .wv-dark .tcard, .wv-dark .route,
.wv-dark .col, .wv-dark .item, .belief .inc{
border-color: rgba(255,255,255,.14);
}
img{ height:auto; }
body.float-on .trs-nav .nav__cta{opacity:0;pointer-events:none;transition:opacity .3s var(--ease)}
.mgrid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(5,minmax(0,1fr));gap:16px;margin-top:8px}
.mgrid>*{min-width:0}
@media(max-width:1000px){.mgrid{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr))}}
@media(max-width:560px){.mgrid{grid-template-columns:1fr}}
.mcard{background:var(--paper);border:1px solid var(--hair);border-radius:var(--r-md);padding:24px 20px;box-shadow:inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.72),0 1px 2px rgba(45,46,55,.05)}
.mcard .mlbl{display:block;font-family:var(--fb);font-size:10px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.2em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--accent-text);margin-bottom:12px}
.mcard h3{font-family:var(--fd);font-weight:500;font-size:22px;line-height:1.1;color:var(--ink);margin:0}
.mcard .wv-mint{display:block;margin:8px 0 12px;font-family:var(--fb);font-size:12.5px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.04em;color:var(--accent-text)}
.mcard p{font-family:var(--fb);font-size:14px;font-weight:300;line-height:1.58;color:var(--ink-soft);margin:0}
.rblocks{max-width:68ch;margin:0 auto}
.rblock{padding:26px 0;border-top:1px solid var(--hair)}
.rblock:last-child{border-bottom:1px solid var(--hair)}
.rblock .rnum{font-family:var(--fd);font-style:italic;font-size:22px;color:var(--accent-text);display:block;margin-bottom:6px}
.rblock h3{font-family:var(--fd);font-weight:500;font-size:24px;line-height:1.15;color:var(--ink);margin:0 0 10px}
.rblock p{font-family:var(--fb);font-size:16px;font-weight:300;line-height:1.66;color:var(--ink);margin:0}
.rblock p+p{margin-top:10px}
.rtruth{margin:26px auto 0;max-width:52ch;text-align:center;font-family:var(--fd);font-style:italic;font-size:clamp(20px,3vw,26px);line-height:1.35;color:var(--ink)}
.sci{max-width:68ch;margin:0 auto}
.sci div{display:grid;grid-template-columns:160px 1fr;gap:16px;padding:16px 0;border-top:1px solid var(--hair);font-family:var(--fb);font-size:15px;font-weight:300;line-height:1.62;color:var(--ink)}
.sci div:last-child{border-bottom:1px solid var(--hair)}
.sci b{font-family:var(--fd);font-weight:500;font-size:18px;line-height:1.3;color:var(--ink)}
@media(max-width:560px){.sci div{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:4px}}
.myths{max-width:68ch;margin:0 auto}
.myth-row{padding:18px 0;border-top:1px solid var(--hair)}
.myth-row:last-child{border-bottom:1px solid var(--hair)}
.myth-row .myth{font-family:var(--fb);font-size:15px;font-weight:300;line-height:1.55;color:var(--ink-soft);margin:0 0 8px}
.myth-row .fact{font-family:var(--fd);font-weight:500;font-size:18px;line-height:1.45;color:var(--ink);margin:0}
.signs{max-width:68ch;margin:26px auto 0;background:var(--stone-soft);border-radius:var(--r-md);padding:22px 24px;font-family:var(--fb);font-size:14.5px;font-weight:300;line-height:1.62;color:var(--ink);box-shadow:inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.72)}
.signs b{display:block;font-size:10.5px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.2em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--accent-text);margin-bottom:8px}
.sp-rail{display:flex;gap:18px;overflow-x:auto;scroll-snap-type:x mandatory;-webkit-overflow-scrolling:touch;padding:2px 0 16px;scrollbar-width:none}
.sp-rail::-webkit-scrollbar{display:none}
.sp-card{flex:0 0 auto;width:min(78vw,300px);scroll-snap-align:start;background:var(--paper);border:1px solid var(--hair);border-radius:var(--r-md);padding:16px 16px 20px;box-shadow:inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.72),0 1px 2px rgba(45,46,55,.05);display:flex;flex-direction:column}
.sp-card img{aspect-ratio:4/5;width:100%;height:auto;object-fit:cover;object-position:center 30%;border-radius:6px;display:block;background:var(--stone)}
.sp-card .sp-city{display:block;margin-top:16px;font-family:var(--fb);font-size:10px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.2em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--accent-text)}
.sp-card h3{font-family:var(--fd);font-weight:500;font-size:21px;line-height:1.15;color:var(--ink);margin:6px 0 2px}
.sp-card .sp-role{font-family:var(--fb);font-size:12.5px;font-weight:500;color:var(--ink-soft);margin:0}
.sp-card .sp-salon{font-family:var(--fb);font-size:13px;font-weight:300;line-height:1.5;color:var(--ink);margin:10px 0 0;padding-top:10px;border-top:1px solid var(--hair)}
.sp-card .sp-bio{font-family:var(--fb);font-size:13.5px;font-weight:300;line-height:1.55;color:var(--ink-soft);margin:10px 0 0;flex:1}
.sp-card .sp-go{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;margin-top:14px;font-family:var(--fb);font-size:11px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--accent-text);text-decoration:none}
@media(min-width:900px){.sp-rail{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));gap:22px;overflow:visible;padding-bottom:0}.sp-card{width:auto}}
@media(min-width:1180px){.sp-rail{grid-template-columns:repeat(4,minmax(0,1fr))}}
.mcard img{aspect-ratio:4/3;width:100%;height:auto;object-fit:cover;border-radius:6px;display:block;background:var(--stone-soft);margin-bottom:14px}
.myth-row .myth,.exp-tile figcaption,.mcard p,.sp-card .sp-role,.sp-card .sp-bio,.p-lg,.stack-anchor{color:#65656C}
.hero-c .nav-link,.sp-card .sp-go{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;min-height:44px}
.trs-nav .brand__wm, .foot .brand__wm{ font-family:var(--fb) !important; font-weight:400 }
.countdown{ justify-content:center }
.grid-4 .loc{ padding:24px 22px 22px 24px }
.loc .wa{ display:inline-block; margin-top:2px; color:inherit; text-decoration:underline; text-underline-offset:3px; text-decoration-color:var(--accent-text) }
.vs-list--meta li b{ flex-shrink:1; min-width:0; text-align:right }
.vs-list--meta li.vs-tabby b{ flex-shrink:0; white-space:nowrap }
.vs-left[hidden]{ display:none }
.foot__legal{ border-top:0; margin-top:0 }
@media (min-width:1024px){ .foot .row{ grid-template-columns:1.4fr 1fr 1fr 1fr; gap:40px } }
@media (min-width:781px) and (max-width:1023px){ .foot .row{ grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr } }
.pdpl__label{ display:block !important }
.pdpl__group{ align-items:flex-start !important }
.pdpl__label > span{ display:block; margin-top:3px; font-size:12px }
.faq .ans{ max-width:none; padding-right:42px }
.soc--linktree{ display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:9px }
.soc--linktree::before{ content:""; flex:0 0 auto; width:15px; height:15px; background:currentColor;
  -webkit-mask:url("data:image/svg+xml,<svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 24 24'><path d='M13.7 5.9 17.5 2l2.2 2.3-4 3.8h5.6v3.2h-5.6l4 3.9-2.2 2.2-5.4-5.4-5.4 5.4-2.2-2.2 4-3.9H2.8V8.1h5.6l-4-3.8L6.6 2l3.8 3.9V0h3.3zM10.4 16.1h3.3V24h-3.3z'/></svg>") center/contain no-repeat; mask:url("data:image/svg+xml,<svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 24 24'><path d='M13.7 5.9 17.5 2l2.2 2.3-4 3.8h5.6v3.2h-5.6l4 3.9-2.2 2.2-5.4-5.4-5.4 5.4-2.2-2.2 4-3.9H2.8V8.1h5.6l-4-3.8L6.6 2l3.8 3.9V0h3.3zM10.4 16.1h3.3V24h-3.3z'/></svg>") center/contain no-repeat }
@media (max-width:600px){ .faq .ans{ padding-right:0 } }
body{ overflow-x:clip; }
.trs-nav .brand__wm{ font-family:var(--fb); font-weight:400; }
.foot .brand__wm{ font-family:var(--fb); font-weight:400; }
.hero-b{ background:var(--paper); padding:0; overflow:hidden; }
.hero-b .split{
  display:grid; grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr; align-items:stretch;
  gap:clamp(20px,3.4vw,48px);
  min-height:min(78vh,720px);
  max-width:var(--maxw); margin-inline:auto; padding-inline:var(--pad-x);
}
.hero-b .htext{
  display:flex; flex-direction:column; justify-content:center;
  padding:clamp(28px,5vw,56px) 0;
  max-width:none;
}
.hero-b .wv-h-1{
  font-family:var(--fd); font-weight:400; color:var(--ink);
  font-size:clamp(30px, min(4.6vw, 5.6vh), 54px);
  line-height:1.06; letter-spacing:-.015em; margin:0; text-wrap:balance;
}
.hero-b .hero-sub{
  margin:18px 0 0; max-width:44ch;
  font-family:var(--fb); font-size:clamp(15.5px,1.4vw,17.5px); font-weight:400;
  letter-spacing:.02em; line-height:1.5; color:var(--ink-soft);
  text-wrap:balance;
}
.hero-b .hero-support{
  margin:20px 0 0; max-width:26ch;
  font-family:var(--fd); font-style:italic; font-weight:500;
  font-size:clamp(20px,2.4vw,28px); line-height:1.34; color:var(--ink);
  text-wrap:balance;
}
.hero-b .cta-row{ margin-top:28px; }
.hero-b .himg{
  background:var(--stone-soft) center/cover no-repeat;
  min-height:340px; border-radius:var(--r-md);
  margin:clamp(20px,3.4vh,36px) 0;
}
@media(max-width:833px){
  .hero-b .split{ grid-template-columns:1fr; min-height:0; gap:0; }
  .hero-b .himg{
    order:-1; width:100%; min-height:0; margin:20px 0 0;
    height:clamp(170px, 30vh, 280px); aspect-ratio:auto;
  }
  .hero-b .htext{ padding-top:24px; text-align:center; align-items:center; }
  .hero-b .hero-sub, .hero-b .hero-support{ margin-inline:auto; }
  .hero-b .cta-row{ display:flex; flex-direction:column; align-items:center; margin-top:24px; }
}
.band-photo{ margin:0 auto 40px; max-width:980px; }
.band-photo img{
  width:100%; height:auto; aspect-ratio:16/7; object-fit:cover;
  display:block; border-radius:var(--r-md); background:var(--stone-soft);
}
@media(max-width:559px){
  .band-photo{ margin-bottom:30px; }
  .band-photo img{ aspect-ratio:4/3; }
}
.band-photo--tall{ max-width:760px; }
.band-photo--tall img{ aspect-ratio:8/7; }
.lane-photo{ margin:0 0 20px; }
.lane-photo img{
  width:100%; height:auto; aspect-ratio:4/5; object-fit:cover;
  display:block; border-radius:var(--r-sm); background:var(--stone-soft);
  border:1px solid var(--hair);

<!-- wp:generateblocks/text {"uniqueId":"c3bada8b","tagName":"h2","htmlAttributes":{"id":"faq-h"}} -->
<h2 class="gb-text" id="faq-h">Extensions, answered.</h2>
<!-- /wp:generateblocks/text --></div>
<!-- /wp:generateblocks/element -->

<!-- wp:html -->
<details class="wv-q"><summary>Which extension method is right for my hair?<span class="chev"></span></summary><div class="ans">It depends on your hair type and what you want them to do. As a guide, Tape-In and Nano Rings are often chosen for fine hair, Beaded Weft for medium to thick hair, Sewn Weft for thick hair and the most volume, and Keratin & Fusion for the most natural movement. Your stylist matches the method, and the weight of hair, to what your own hair can carry comfortably at your free Confidence Mapping, so the right method starts with understanding your hair.</div></details>
<details class="wv-q"><summary>What is the difference between tapes, wefts, rings and bonds?<span class="chev"></span></summary><div class="ans">Tape-In panels sit flat against the root. Nano Rings hold small sections with a tiny ring, with no glue or heat. Beaded and Sewn Weft attach a full row of hair, held at beads or sewn onto a fine braid, for the most volume. Keratin & Fusion bonds attach strand by strand and move most like your own hair.</div></details>
<details class="wv-q"><summary>Why do extensions need maintenance?<span class="chev"></span></summary><div class="ans">Your own hair keeps growing underneath, roughly 1 to 1.5cm a month, so every week the point of attachment sits a little further from your scalp and the blend starts to show. Most women are sold the fitting and never told about the rhythm that keeps it. That was never yours to work out alone. A move-up is a removal and refit that brings them back up to the root. The rhythm is what makes the extensions last.</div></details>
<details class="wv-q"><summary>How often do I need a move-up?<span class="chev"></span></summary><div class="ans">It is set at your consultation and depends on your method and how quickly your hair grows. As a guide, Tape-In and Sewn Weft every 6 to 8 weeks, Nano Rings and Beaded Weft every 8 to 10, and Keratin & Fusion every 10 to 12.</div></details>
<details class="wv-q"><summary>How much do hair extensions cost in Dubai and Abu Dhabi?<span class="chev"></span></summary><div class="ans">New hair is priced by method and the amount of hair you need, at your free Confidence Mapping. New hair starts from AED 1,800 for Weft, AED 2,200 for Tape-In and AED 2,800 for Nano Rings. The New Hair & Maintain Bundle is AED 6,000, which works out at around AED 500 a month for your full application plus 12 months of care. Move-ups start at AED 450 a pack for Tape-In and AED 450 a row for Sewn and Beaded Weft. Nano Rings and Keratin & Fusion are AED 500 an hour.</div></details>
<details class="wv-q"><summary>Do you charge to remove extensions fitted somewhere else?<span class="chev"></span></summary><div class="ans">Taking out Tape-In, Nano Rings or weft extensions is included when you are having new hair fitted with us. Keratin & Fusion bonds take longer to remove, so removal is charged by the hour.</div></details>
<details class="wv-q"><summary>Do hair extensions damage your natural hair?<span class="chev"></span></summary><div class="ans">Not when they are fitted by a trained stylist and kept to the move-up rhythm for your method. Damage comes from missed move-ups, the wrong method for your hair or too much tension. Tension left too long can cause traction alopecia, hair loss from ongoing pulling. Caught early it is reversible, which is why we check your scalp and hairline at every visit.</div></details>
<details class="wv-q"><summary>How do I look after my extensions?<span class="chev"></span></summary><div class="ans">Wash with extension-safe, sulphate-free home care and put moisture back through the mid-lengths and ends, as extension hair has no scalp feeding it. Plait or tie your hair loosely before bed and keep your styling loose, as tight ponytails and buns pull on the point of attachment.</div></details>
<details class="wv-q"><summary>Can I spread the cost, or give it as a gift?<span class="chev"></span></summary><div class="ans">Yes. Maintain Plus splits into 4 interest-free payments of AED 750 with Tabby, and the New Hair & Maintain Bundle into 4 of AED 1,500. Maintain Essentials is cash or card. Any package can be issued in her name, ready to book, with a note from you.</div></details>
<details class="wv-q"><summary>Do I pay a deposit, and what if something does not feel right?<span class="chev"></span></summary><div class="ans">A refundable AED 500 deposit secures every fitting and comes off your final bill. Cancellations need 48 hours’ notice. Every treatment service is covered by the Confidence Promise, set out just above where you start your consultation.</div></details>
<details class="wv-q"><summary>Which salons offer extensions?<span class="chev"></span></summary><div class="ans">All four: Khalifa City A and Mamsha Al Saadiyat in Abu Dhabi, Al Quoz 1 and Motor City in Dubai.</div></details>

<script>
/* page script */
(function(){
  var back=document.getElementById('tmcBack'),img=document.getElementById('tmcImg'),ttl=document.getElementById('tmcTitle'),x=document.getElementById('tmcX'),opener=null;
  function open(c){opener=c;var n=c.getAttribute('data-name'),r=c.getAttribute('data-role');ttl.textContent=n+' · '+r;img.alt=n+'’s Tara Rose stylist card';img.src=c.getAttribute('data-card');back.hidden=false;document.documentElement.style.overflow='hidden';x.focus();}
  function close(){back.hidden=true;img.removeAttribute('src');document.documentElement.style.overflow='';if(opener){try{opener.focus();}catch(e){}}}
  document.addEventListener('click',function(e){var c=e.target.closest&&e.target.closest('.tmc-card');if(c){e.preventDefault();open(c);}});
  x.addEventListener('click',close);
  back.addEventListener('click',function(e){if(e.target===back)close();});
  document.addEventListener('keydown',function(e){if(e.key==='Escape'&&!back.hidden)close();});
})();
</script>
<script>
/* page script */
/* Level the Blonde Menu cards: intros get the height of the tallest when the cards sit side by side. */
(function(){
  var ps=[].slice.call(document.querySelectorAll('.gcards .plancard__body>p'));
  if(!ps.length) return;
  var level=function(){
    ps.forEach(function(p){ p.style.minHeight=''; });
    var cards=document.querySelectorAll('.gcards .gcard');
    if(cards.length<2||cards[0].getBoundingClientRect().top!==cards[1].getBoundingClientRect().top) return;
    var h=Math.max.apply(null,ps.map(function(p){ return p.getBoundingClientRect().height; }));
    ps.forEach(function(p){ p.style.minHeight=h+'px'; });
  };
  window.addEventListener('resize',level,{passive:true});
  window.addEventListener('load',level);
  if(document.fonts&&document.fonts.ready) document.fonts.ready.then(level);
  level();
})();
</script>
<script>
/* page script */
/* Hero height: measured, because the draft bar and nav wrap differently by width. */
(function(){
  var root=document.documentElement;
  var fit=function(){
    var bar=document.querySelector('.draft-bar'), nav=document.querySelector('.trs-nav'), tr=document.querySelector('.trust');
    root.style.setProperty('--top-h',((bar?bar.offsetHeight:0)+(nav?nav.offsetHeight:0))+'px');
    if(tr) root.style.setProperty('--trust-h',tr.offsetHeight+'px');
  };
  window.addEventListener('resize',fit,{passive:true});
  if(document.fonts&&document.fonts.ready) document.fonts.ready.then(fit);
  fit();
})();
</script>
<script>
/* page script */
/* Where to start: mark the statement she tapped and outline the card it leads to, so she can see where she landed. */
(function(){
  var picks=[].slice.call(document.querySelectorAll('.pick__card'));
  if(!picks.length) return;
  picks.forEach(function(a){
    a.addEventListener('click',function(){
      picks.forEach(function(p){ p.classList.toggle('is-picked',p===a); p.setAttribute('aria-current',p===a?'true':'false'); });
      document.querySelectorAll('.plancard.is-target').forEach(function(c){ c.classList.remove('is-target'); });
      var t=document.querySelector(a.getAttribute('href'));
      if(!t) return;
      var cards=t.classList.contains('plancard')?[t]:[].slice.call(t.querySelectorAll('.plancard'));
      cards.forEach(function(c){ c.classList.add('is-target'); });
    });
  });
})();
</script>
<script>
/* page script */
/* Methods: pick a rhythm, see only its methods. */
(function(){
  var btns=[].slice.call(document.querySelectorAll('.mv-switch button'));
  var cards=[].slice.call(document.querySelectorAll('.mv-card'));
  if(!btns.length) return;
  var show=function(g){ cards.forEach(function(c){ c.hidden=c.getAttribute('data-g')!==g; }); };
  btns.forEach(function(b){ b.addEventListener('click',function(){
    btns.forEach(function(o){ o.setAttribute('aria-checked',String(o===b)); });
    show(b.getAttribute('data-g'));
  }); });
  show('68');
})();
</script>

<script>
/* page script */
/* Sticky menu: the chip for the option on screen is the dark one, and the row scrolls to keep it in view. */
(function(){
  var bar=document.querySelector('.offer-nav'); if(!bar) return;
  var chips=[].slice.call(bar.querySelectorAll('.ochip')), row=bar.querySelector('.offer-nav__row');
  var targets=chips.map(function(a){ return document.getElementById(a.getAttribute('href').slice(1)); });
  var nav=document.querySelector('.trs-nav'), tick=false, last=-2;
  var run=function(){
    tick=false;
    var top=(nav?nav.offsetHeight:75)+bar.offsetHeight+Math.round(window.innerHeight*0.3), cur=-1;
    targets.forEach(function(t,i){ if(t&&t.getBoundingClientRect().top<=top) cur=i; });
    if(cur===last) return; last=cur;
    chips.forEach(function(a,i){ a.classList.toggle('active',i===cur); });
    if(cur>-1&&row.scrollWidth>row.clientWidth) row.scrollTo({left:chips[cur].offsetLeft-row.offsetLeft-12,behavior:'smooth'});
  };
  window.addEventListener('scroll',function(){ if(!tick){ tick=true; setTimeout(run,50); } },{passive:true});
  window.addEventListener('resize',run,{passive:true});
  run();
})();
</script>

<script>
/* js/nav-scroll.js */
/* Nav shadow on scroll, the sticky offer nav's numbers, and the scroll-spy.
   --nav-h and --sticky-h are measured rather than hard-coded, because the offer
   nav wraps to two rows of chips on a phone and the anchor offsets have to clear
   whatever it actually renders at. .stuck adds the drop shadow only while the bar
   is docked under the brand nav.
   The spy keeps the URL hash and the highlighted chip matched to the group on
   screen while she scrolls (Kate, 25 Aug: the URL said blow-dries while she was
   reading courses). replaceState, not pushState, so back does not replay every
   group she scrolled past. The blonde band is in the spy map without a chip: the
   hash says where she is, and no chip pretends to be it. */
(function(){
  var nav=document.querySelector('.trs-nav');
  if(!nav) return;
  var bar=document.querySelector('.offer-nav');
  var zone=document.querySelector('.menu-zone');
  var root=document.documentElement;
  var SPY=['o-plans','o-menu']
    .map(function(id){ return document.getElementById(id); }).filter(Boolean);
  var chips={};
  document.querySelectorAll('.ochip').forEach(function(a){
    chips[a.getAttribute('href').slice(1)]=a;
  });
  var lastSpy=null, ticking=false;

  var measure=function(){
    var nh=nav.offsetHeight;
    root.style.setProperty('--nav-h',nh+'px');
    if(bar) root.style.setProperty('--sticky-h',(nh+bar.offsetHeight+16)+'px');
  };

  var spy=function(){
    if(!zone||!SPY.length) return;
    var offset=nav.offsetHeight+(bar?bar.offsetHeight:0)+24;
    /* A group counts as "on screen" once its heading has risen into the top 40% of the
       window below the sticky bars, so the chip changes when she is reading the new group,
       not only when its heading touches the bars. */
    var lead=offset+Math.round(window.innerHeight*0.4);
    var current=null;
    if(zone.getBoundingClientRect().bottom>offset){
      for(var i=0;i<SPY.length;i++){
        if(SPY[i].getBoundingClientRect().top<=lead) current=SPY[i].id;
      }
    }
    if(current===lastSpy) return;
    lastSpy=current;
    try{ history.replaceState(null,'',current?'#'+current:location.pathname+location.search); }catch(e){}
    for(var id in chips) chips[id].classList.toggle('active',id===current);
  };

  var os=function(){
    nav.classList.toggle('scrolled', window.scrollY>14);
    if(bar) bar.classList.toggle('stuck',
      window.scrollY>0 && bar.getBoundingClientRect().top<=nav.offsetHeight+1);
    if(!ticking){
      ticking=true;
      requestAnimationFrame(function(){ ticking=false; spy(); });
    }
  };

  window.addEventListener('scroll',os,{passive:true});
  window.addEventListener('resize',measure,{passive:true});
  window.addEventListener('load',measure);
  /* The chip rows reflow when the webfont swaps in, so measure again after it. */
  if(document.fonts&&document.fonts.ready) document.fonts.ready.then(measure);
  measure(); os();
})();

</script>
<script>
/* js/tracking.js */
/* Tracking layer, Layer 5 F. Fills the hidden fields. No third-party script, no
   cookie of our own beyond the two stores below, so nothing here needs consent.
   TEMPLATE: swap __FORM_ENDPOINT__ for the GHL inbound webhook. Inert until set. */
(function(){
  /* Salon numbers from each Google Business Profile, checked 13 Oct 2026. Motor City's WhatsApp is the 52 496 0903 line (Kate, 13 Oct 2026); its GBP shows the landline. */
  var SALON_LINKS='<a href="https://wa.me/971502811494" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Khalifa City A</a>, <a href="https://wa.me/971501968720" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Mamsha Al Saadiyat</a>, <a href="https://wa.me/971556245520" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Al Quoz</a>, or <a href="https://wa.me/971524960903" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Motor City</a>';
  /* DAVID: replace __FORM_ENDPOINT__ below with the real inbound webhook URL (keep the quotes).
     While it still says __FORM_ENDPOINT__ the form is inert and shows "preview, nothing was sent". */
  var FORM_ENDPOINT="__FORM_ENDPOINT__";
  var f=document.querySelector('#book form'); if(!f) return;
  var q=new URLSearchParams(location.search);
  var set=function(n,v){ var el=f.querySelector('[name="'+n+'"]'); if(el&&v!=null&&v!=='') el.value=v; };
  var store=function(k,v){ try{ localStorage.setItem(k,v); }catch(e){} };
  var load=function(k){ try{ return localStorage.getItem(k); }catch(e){ return null; } };
  var cookie=function(n){ var m=document.cookie.match('(^|; )'+n+'=([^;]*)'); return m?decodeURIComponent(m[2]):''; };

  ['utm_source','utm_medium','utm_campaign','utm_content','utm_term'].forEach(function(k){ set(k, q.get(k)||''); });
  var gclid=q.get('gclid')||load('trs_gclid'), fbclid=q.get('fbclid')||load('trs_fbclid');
  if(q.get('gclid')) store('trs_gclid',q.get('gclid'));
  if(q.get('fbclid')) store('trs_fbclid',q.get('fbclid'));
  set('gclid',gclid); set('fbclid',fbclid);
  set('fbp',cookie('_fbp'));
  set('fbc', cookie('_fbc') || (fbclid ? 'fb.1.'+Date.now()+'.'+fbclid : ''));

  var touch=JSON.stringify({src:q.get('utm_source')||'',med:q.get('utm_medium')||'',cmp:q.get('utm_campaign')||'',ref:document.referrer||'',path:location.pathname});
  if(!load('trs_first_touch')) store('trs_first_touch',touch);
  set('first_touch', load('trs_first_touch')||touch);
  set('last_touch', touch);
  set('landing_path', load('trs_landing_path') || (store('trs_landing_path',location.pathname), location.pathname));
  set('referrer', document.referrer||'');

  /* Session ref, so a WhatsApp thread can be matched back to a session. */
  var ref=load('trs_ref');
  if(!ref){ ref='JE-'+Math.random().toString(36).slice(2,6).toUpperCase(); store('trs_ref',ref); }
  set('ref',ref);
  document.querySelectorAll('a[href*="wa.me"]').forEach(function(a){
    a.href = a.href + encodeURIComponent(' (ref '+ref+')');
  });

  var svc=q.get('svc'); if(svc){ var s=document.getElementById('svc'); if(s) s.value=svc; }

  /* Layer 4 tags. channel and branch arrive on the URL, because the GBP booking links
     carry ?channel=gbp&branch=<slug> and the four profiles cannot be told apart without
     them. product and emirate derive from her own selections, never typed. */
  set('channel', q.get('channel')||'');
  var urlBranch=q.get('branch')||'';
  set('branch', urlBranch);
  /* offering: uses Emma's exact GHL tag vocabulary so the page feeds her pipeline
     without a translation step. product stays look-vs-door, which is what Layer 4
     measures the conversion on. */
  var OFFERING={smooth:'keratin-smoothing','smooth-frizz':'keratin-smoothing','smooth-straight':'keratin-smoothing','smooth-refresh':'keratin-smoothing',toner:'toner-reset',treatment:'treatment-blowdry',bundle:'blowdry',
    scalp:'treatment-blowdry',course:'treatment-course'};
  /* branch, in Emma's GHL vocabulary. Her list has no tag for "either Dubai salon", so
     that one is left blank rather than guessed; the salon field still carries her answer. */
  var BRANCH={'khalifa-city':'abudhabi','saadiyat':'abudhabi','either-abudhabi':'abudhabi',
    'al-quoz':'dubai-alquoz','motor-city':'dubai-motorcity'};
  /* Derived fields must CLEAR as well as fill. set() above deliberately ignores an
     empty value, which is right for a UTM that arrives once and must not be wiped by
     a later empty read. It is wrong here: if she picks The Smooth Edit and then
     changes to 'not sure', a sticky set() would send offering:smooth-edit to GHL for
     a woman who told us she does not know. So these three assign unconditionally. */
  var reset=function(n,v){ var el=f.querySelector('[name="'+n+'"]'); if(el) el.value=v; };
  var deriveTags=function(){
    var sv=(document.getElementById('svc')||{}).value||'';
    var sa=(document.getElementById('salon')||{}).value||'';
    reset('product', sv ? (sv==='look'?'look':(sv==='unsure'?'':'door')) : '');
    reset('offering', OFFERING[sv]||'');
    reset('emirate', sa ? ((sa==='al-quoz'||sa==='motor-city'||sa==='either-dubai')?'dubai':'abudhabi') : '');
    /* A GBP link carries ?branch= and wins. Everything else, Instagram, a caption link,
       a stylist's own bio, arrives without one, so her salon choice fills it: Emma's spec
       wants a branch tag on every lead, not only on the ones that came from Google. */
    if(!urlBranch) reset('branch', BRANCH[sa]||'');
  };
  f.addEventListener('change',deriveTags); deriveTags();

  f.addEventListener('submit',function(e){
    e.preventDefault();
    var req=f.querySelectorAll('[required]');
    for(var i=0;req.length>i;i++){
      var el=req[i];
      if((el.type==='checkbox'&&!el.checked)||(el.type!=='checkbox'&&!String(el.value).trim())){ el.focus(); return; }
    }
    var data={};
    f.querySelectorAll('[name]').forEach(function(el){
      if(el.type==='checkbox'){ data[el.name]=el.checked; }
      else if(el.value){ data[el.name]=el.value; }
    });
    if(data.cc&&data.whatsapp){ data.whatsapp=data.cc+' '+data.whatsapp; delete data.cc; }
    if(FORM_ENDPOINT.indexOf("__FORM_ENDPOINT__")===-1){
      try{ fetch(FORM_ENDPOINT,{method:"POST",headers:{"Content-Type":"application/json"},body:JSON.stringify(data)}); }catch(err){}
    }
    var t=document.createElement('div'); t.className='form-thanks';
    t.innerHTML = FORM_ENDPOINT.indexOf('__FORM_ENDPOINT__')===-1
      ? '<h3>Thank you. We have you.</h3><p>We will come back to you on WhatsApp with a time. Your reference is '+ref+'.</p>'
      : '<h3>This is a preview, so nothing was sent.</h3><p>To book now, message your salon on WhatsApp: '+SALON_LINKS+'.</p>';
    f.parentNode.replaceChild(t,f); t.scrollIntoView({behavior:'smooth'});
  });
})();

</script>
<script>
/* js/submit-guard.js */
/* The submit button looked alive before consent was ticked, so a woman could tap it
   and nothing would happen. Disabled until the form is actually submittable. */
(function(){
  var f=document.querySelector('#book form'); if(!f) return;
  var btn=f.querySelector('button[type=submit]'); if(!btn) return;
  var sync=function(){
    var ok=true;
    f.querySelectorAll('[required]').forEach(function(el){
      if((el.type==='checkbox'&&!el.checked)||(el.type!=='checkbox'&&!String(el.value).trim())) ok=false;
    });
    btn.toggleAttribute('disabled',!ok);
    btn.setAttribute('aria-disabled',String(!ok));
  };
  f.addEventListener('input',sync); f.addEventListener('change',sync); sync();
})();

</script>
